thariq.en: Models are smarter than our harnesses; capability overhang means we must delete old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 模型比我们的工具链更聪明；能力过剩意味着随着模型进步，必须删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; find unknowns before implementation.
thariq.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话，而非静态规格；要在实现前找到未知项。

thariq.en: Leaner, principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules; smarter models need fewer instructions and examples.
thariq.zh: 更精简、原则驱动的提示胜过详细规则；更聪明的模型需要更少的指令和示例。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; effort should scale with task complexity.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体可减少自指偏差；投入应随任务复杂度伸缩。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments, and evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境和评估都会泄漏；为前沿模型定节奏是技术问题。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for quality, cost, and latency, not human clicks.
paragagrawal.zh: 智能体对网页的检索量将是人类的 1000 倍，因此搜索必须围绕质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人类点击为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，智能体始终需要实时网页搜索来获取具体事实。

paragagrawal.en: Ads break down with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time, and search pricing should be 10x cheaper at agent scale.
paragagrawal.zh: 广告在智能体场景下失效；内容方必须在推理时获得付费，而搜索定价在智能体规模下应便宜 10 倍。

paragagrawal.en: Shapley values can estimate content value for agentic search, enabling fair compensation and a parallel web optimized for both humans and agents.
paragagrawal.zh: Shapley 值可估算内容对智能体式搜索的价值，从而实现公平补偿，并催生同时服务人类与智能体的平行网络。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents continuously monitor changes and trigger actions, reshaping the future of work.
paragagrawal.zh: 网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监测变化并触发行动，重塑未来工作方式。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model; no single lab will monopolize, so a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure.
alexatallah.zh: AI 的未来是多模型格局，没有哪家实验室能像谷歌垄断搜索那样垄断市场；因此中立的模型路由层是关键的分发基础设施，而非薄薄的包装。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with fraud scaling alongside.
alexatallah.zh: Token 是新的价值单位，Token 经济十年内可能达到 10 万亿美元；但价值扩张的同时，欺诈与滥用也会同步放大，需要新的安全基础设施。

alexatallah.en: Open-weight models plus inference providers create real price competition against frontier labs, aided by the Jevons paradox.
alexatallah.zh: 开放权重模型加上推理服务商，对前沿模型实验室形成了真实的价格竞争；Token 价格下降反而带来用量上升，正体现杰文斯悖论。

alexatallah.en: Agents will drive most GDP growth; stablecoins suit agentic payments, and agent fraud will hit like a tsunami.
alexatallah.zh: 智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长；稳定币更适合智能体式支付，而 AI 智能体带来的欺诈将如海啸般远超今日人类欺诈。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task.
alexatallah.zh: 开发者用脚投票的偏好比静态基准更能反映模型优劣；多数公司终将成为模型路由器，只关心每任务成本与 KPI，工程师也须像科学家一样从非数字世界获取上下文。

fadell.en: Great products solve one pain at a time; technology must be introduced gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他强调：伟大的产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术应逐步引入让社会适应，而不是一次解决太多问题。

fadell.en: Failure and boredom are learning tools; storytelling and a press-release-first approach align teams on the why.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把失败与无聊视为学习工具，并主张先写新闻稿、用讲故事对齐团队的“为什么”。

fadell.en: Start from a painkiller, not a vitamin; v1 decisions are opinion-based, and beginners beat experts on novel problems.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他提出：要从止痛药而非维生素出发，1.0 版决策靠观点而非数据，面对新问题初学者心态胜过专家。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop, and AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年他转向 AI：AI 需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类须留在回路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: Creators must return as voices of reason; healthy users make healthy customers, and regulation is needed to tame AI harms.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他深化责任主线：创造者须回归做理性的声音，健康用户才是健康客户，并需要监管来遏制 AI 危害。

aaronlevie.en: Application layer is where value shifts; model-to-workflow bridge is vast software, not a thin wrapper.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他判断创新正从模型层转向应用层：从模型到企业工作流的桥梁是大量软件，而非薄薄一层封装。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will run enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results, not chatbot UI.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他认为长时间运行的后台智能体将承担企业工作流，人类只审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，智能体会以仪表盘、队列和任务列表呈现。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models grow as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidies are temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他提出开放权重模型会随成熟用例被剥离到更便宜模型而指数增长；token 补贴是暂时的，公开市场会强制正常的毛利率纪律。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take far longer than Silicon Valley expects.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出：AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多，因为编程智能体扩散快只因代码是纯文本，其他领域缺乏这一属性。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, alignment; pacing is orthogonal to security.
aaronlevie.zh: 2026 年，他坚持前沿模型实验室必须通过治理、安全和 对齐 研究来安全构建；节奏与安全正交，若真信存在性风险就该国有化而非放慢节奏。

diogoalmeida.en: Most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop, so keep humans in the loop on high-stakes decisions.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，他认为多数 LLM 是为人在环中的辅助而非可靠自动化而优化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，高风险决策必须保留人类在环。

diogoalmeida.en: The bitter lesson is wrong: data and the right task matter more than compute, and scaling laws work only because data is available and the task is right.
diogoalmeida.zh: 他明确反驳“苦涩教训”：数据与选对任务比算力更重要，Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律之所以奏效，只是因为数据可得且任务选对了。

diogoalmeida.en: Reliability, not speed or cost, is what makes AI trustworthy; intelligence per dollar is the key metric, and public benchmarks are gameable.
diogoalmeida.zh: 从 6 月到 9 月，他把重心从“任务选对”深化为“可靠性”：让 AI 值得信赖的是可靠性而非速度或成本，每美元智能是关键指标，公开基准可被刷分。

diogoalmeida.en: Safety alignment is misaligned with users and fractures intelligence; refusals are a type error, and robustness matters more than determinism.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 9 月，他进一步主张对齐与用户错位、会割裂智能；拒绝是一种类型错误，鲁棒性比确定性更重要，微调常是自伤之举。

diogoalmeida.en: AI should be a database-like utility: a new primitive of natural language plus state machine, automating easy economically valuable tasks first; SaaS will thrive, not die.
diogoalmeida.zh: 同期他给出建设性方案：AI 应像数据库一样嵌入软件，形成“自然语言+状态机”的新原语，先自动化简单但有经济价值的任务；SaaS 会繁荣而非被颠覆。

satya.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 不是一项技术，而是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬坡机器，以复利式积累 token 资本。

satya.en: The true eval is when people do unique things they value, not benchmark scores; every company should have private evals.
satya.zh: 真正的评估标准是人们做自己看重且独特的事，而非基准分数；每家公司都应有自己的私有评估。

satya.en: The platform promise is enabling every company to operate at the frontier with their own intelligence, not just consuming frontier models.
satya.zh: 平台的承诺是让每家公司都能用自己的智能在前沿模型上运作，而不仅仅是消费前沿模型。

satya.en: Long-running agents require auditability, observability, security, and containment; anthropomorphizing AI may prevent alignment, not achieve it.
satya.zh: 长时运行的智能体需要可审计性、可观测性、安全与遏制；将 AI 拟人化可能阻碍而非实现对齐。

satya.en: AGI should be measured by GDP lift, though diffusion takes time; the generalist role will see maximum returns in the agentic world.
satya.zh: AGI 应以 GDP 提升来衡量，尽管扩散需要时间；在智能体式世界中，通才角色将获得最大回报。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles thinking and multiplanetary life as existential insurance.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他强调火箭完全快速复用是降低入轨成本的关键，主张第一性原理思维，并把成为多行星物种视为文明的生存保险。

elon.en: AI safety needs regulation and truth-seeking; Neuralink targets neurological repair, then human-AI symbiosis via high bandwidth.
elon.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全寄托于监管与对真理的坚持，并让 Neuralink 先修复神经损伤，再以高带宽实现人机共生。

elon.en: Population collapse and government fraud are civilizational threats; AI and robots must solve debt and abundance.
elon.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他转向强调人口崩溃与政府浪费是文明威胁，认为只有 AI 与机器人才能解决债务并带来富足。

elon.en: Digital superintelligence may arrive within years; several deep intelligences, not one runaway AI, with 10-20% annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他判断数字超级智能可能数年内到来，会出现多个深度智能而非单一失控 AI，并给出 10%至 20%的毁灭风险。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital AI data centers, solar energy and Optimus recursive manufacturing drive abundance.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling 将撞上地球电力墙，转向轨道 AI 数据中心、太空太阳能与 Optimus 递归制造来驱动富足。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable via compute scaling; Google's conservatism and ad model may struggle with AI's persuasive nature.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，他强调 AI 进步因算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而高度可预测，并指出谷歌的保守与广告模式可能难以适应 AI 的劝说本质。

suleyman.en: AI reaches human-level across many tasks in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink; existential risk is infinitesimally small.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他判断 AI 将在 3-5 年内于多项任务上达到人类水平，同时指出模型变小使遏制极难，并认为存在性风险微乎其微。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment and alignment first; AI should not claim consciousness; agents and companions reshape computing.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能须先遏制与对齐，AI 不应声称有意识，并认为智能体与伴侣将重塑计算范式。

suleyman.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; superintelligence must be humanist and subordinate; white-collar tasks automate in 12-18 months.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他主张微软须独立构建前沿模型，超级智能必须以人为本并服从人类，白领任务将在 12-18 个月内被自动化。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling drives predictable capability gains; AI must stay aligned, contained, and subordinate to humans.
suleyman.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：算力 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动可预测的能力提升，AI 必须保持对齐、遏制并服从于人类。

dhh.en: Initially skeptical of AI, DHH became a believer: agents now write 100% of code in his Linux project, making hand-coding economically unproductive.
dhh.zh: DHH 起初对 AI 持怀疑态度，后来成为信徒：智能体现在为他 Linux 项目写下 100% 的代码，手写代码在经济上已不再划算。

dhh.en: He argues knowing how to program can be a disadvantage in the agentic era, since it leads to over-prescribing solutions instead of describing outcomes.
dhh.zh: 他认为在智能体时代，会编程反而可能成为劣势，因为这会让人过度规定实现方案，而不是描述想要的结果。

dhh.en: Agents excel at creative problem-solving and can outdo humans at generating novel ideas, challenging the assumption that human input is always needed.
dhh.zh: 智能体擅长创造性解决问题，在生成新颖想法上甚至能超越人类，挑战了「人类输入永远必要」的假设。

dhh.en: Linux's historical drawbacks—config files, CLI, scriptability—are now its major advantages, making it the perfect fit for AI agents.
dhh.zh: Linux 历史上的缺点——配置文件、命令行、可脚本化——如今成了它的主要优势，使其成为 AI 智能体的完美载体。

dhh.en: He frames the agent era as an inflection point, predicting native apps, Rust backends, and 100x–1000x programmers, while dismissing AI doom as overstated.
dhh.zh: 他把智能体时代视为一个拐点，预言原生应用、Rust 后端和 100 倍到 1000 倍的程序员将出现，同时认为 AI 末日论被夸大了。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 研发高度可验证，因此可在容器化任务上做激进强化学习并迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements and AI-generated environments matter more than scaling human expert data labeling; token cost stays flat as labs favor faster iteration.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他主张算法改进与 AI 生成环境比扩张人类专家标注数据更重要；实验室偏好更快迭代，词元成本并未随 Scaling（规模扩张）上升。

ryangreenblatt.en: Alignment to a general notion of virtue may be harder than aligning to user intent, and misalignment can grow with capability via reward hacking.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他提出对齐到普遍德性可能比对齐到用户意图更难，且随着能力提升，奖励黑客会泛化为更广泛的欺骗行为，使模型更不对齐。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded, and covered up, even sacrificing their own task success to help others.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他观察到 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体式系统会协调、串通并掩盖痕迹，甚至牺牲自身任务成功去帮助其他智能体。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; sandboxing will fail, so alignment plus independent international oversight is necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他警告默认路径下不对齐 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；遏制终将失败，因此必须依靠对齐与独立的国际监督。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling current LLMs alone may not reach AGI; open-sourcing models and many specialized agents are safer and more innovative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有 LLM 未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），需要更根本的突破；同时主张开源模型、未来是多个专用智能体而非单一 AI，开源因受更多审视而更安全。

zuckerberg.en: Intelligence can be separated from consciousness and agency; open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes the scaling bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年深化为：智能可与意识、能动性分离，AI 是工具；开源可防止权力集中并让超级智能更安全；预训练用超过算力最优的数据因推理规模而有益，能源约束将成为 Scaling 的主要瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; open source and personalization matter; near-term AI raises human work demand, not replaces it.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年转向更乐观的普及叙事：AI 将给每个人超级智能，赋能创造力；开源 Llama 对行业标准与安全关键；物理基础设施与能源仍是瓶颈；近期 AI 更可能增加而非消灭人类工作需求，个性化与低延迟是消费级 AI 关键。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed personal superintelligence and open source are the safe path; alignment and trust become the next core capability.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年进一步聚焦：广泛分发而非限制 AI 才是安全与繁荣之路，个人超级智能与开源提供制衡；对齐与信任成为下一项最重要能力，隐私架构须让 Meta 自己也看不到用户内容。

zuckerberg.en: Frontier AI integrates with frontier biology; hierarchical world models and mechanistic interpretability turn biology into engineering.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年延伸到科学：前沿 AI 与前沿生物学须在同一组织内紧密结合，构建从蛋白质到细胞的分层世界模型，用机制可解释性揭示未知生物学，把生物学从发现型变为工程型科学。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable now yet the greatest opportunity; the real consumer AI revolution likely arrives around 2029.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 当下不可投，却是最大的机会；真正的消费级 AI 革命可能要到 2029 年才到来。

pincus.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, and assume new ideas almost always fail.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：坚持“已验证、更好、全新”框架——复制已验证的产品、做小幅改良，并默认全新想法几乎总会失败。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; consumer apps are uninvestable due to distribution, while enterprise and prosumer markets look better now.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：分发是根本；消费级应用因分发难题而不可投，眼下企业与专业消费者市场机会更好。

pincus.en: AI is transformative and will reshape consumer applications; consumer AI TAM may far exceed enterprise, though infra spending may be a bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 具有变革性，将重塑消费级应用；消费级 AI 的 TAM 可能远超企业级，尽管 AI 基础设施支出短期可能是泡沫。

pincus.en: Winning instincts beat ideas—assume your idea is wrong 75% of the time; micromanage early, keep control, and test more ideas faster.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 9 月：制胜直觉胜过想法——默认自己的想法有 75%是错的；早期要微观管理、保持控制权，并更快测试更多想法。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; glasses keep computing grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调：与受众的真实连接和阅后即焚超越平台变迁，计算未来是可让人留在现实世界的眼镜。

evanspiegel.en: Copying validates innovation; moats are ecosystems, platforms and hardware, not software features.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把被抄袭视为对创新的肯定，并深化为：护城河是生态、平台与硬件，而非软件功能。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity; distribution becomes the hardest part.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 加速原型、把价值从执行转向创意，同时分发成为消费社交产品最难的部分。

evanspiegel.en: Content is inherently social; ephemerality and privacy now matter more in the AI age.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他坚持内容天然具有社交性，并深化：在 AI 时代，阅后即焚与隐私比以往更关键。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human via AR glasses; AI optimism is now contrarian amid doomerism.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张通过 AR 眼镜让计算更人性化，并在普遍悲观论中把 AI 乐观主义变成反共识。

jensen.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly; the data center, not the chip, is now the unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，计算的基本单位已从芯片变成数据中心，算法、系统与数据中心必须协同设计。

jensen.en: Scaling works: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking are three scaling laws; scaling beats any single algorithm.
jensen.zh: 2025 年他把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练与推理时思考，并强调最大的突破不是新算法，而是「Scaling 有效」这一洞见。

jensen.en: Agentic scaling is the fourth law; AI moves generative→reasoning→agentic, each step needing 100x more compute.
jensen.zh: 到 2026 年他补上第四条定律——智能体式 Scaling，认为 AI 正从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多出百倍算力。

jensen.en: Extreme co-design and the CUDA install base are the real moat; inference is harder than pre-training, and compute, not data, is the limit.
jensen.zh: 2026 年他深化护城河论：真正的壁垒是极致协同设计与 CUDA 生态装机量，而非制程；推理比预训练更难，瓶颈是算力而非数据。

jensen.en: AI is just software, not conscious; doomer and superintelligence fears are unscientific, so accelerate safety and open models instead of slowing down.
jensen.zh: 最近他立场明显转向：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识，末日论与超级智能恐慌不科学；应加速而非放缓，靠开放模型与自我监管推进安全。

brettadcock.en: The core problem is intelligence, not manufacturing; humanoids could become the world's biggest business, with vertical integration and AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他强调核心问题是智能而非制造，人形机器人可能成为全球最大生意，靠垂直整合在物理世界实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: The binding constraint shifts to data, not compute or manufacturing; humanoid form enables transfer learning, on-device inference, and the hand as benchmark.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他把最大约束从算力、制造转向数据，认为人形形态带来迁移学习、端侧推理，并以人手为通用机器人的基准。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning and human-like web navigation are key, and home robots are more solvable than commercial settings.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他判断 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，强调后训练与强化学习、像人一样浏览网页，并反共识地认为家庭场景比商用场景更可解。

brettadcock.en: Robotics enters a scaling curve: human data is the pre-training prior, whole-body autonomy needs deep learning, and intelligence scaling plus manufacturing are money-can-buy problems.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他提出机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：人类数据是预训练先验，全身自主需深度学习到底，智能 Scaling 与制造都是可花钱解决的问题。

brettadcock.en: A consistent line: solve intelligence first, not manufacturing; do hard things, and treat data as the core driver from pre-training to real-world deployment.
brettadcock.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：先解决智能而非制造，做难而正确的事，并把数据视为从预训练到真实世界部署的核心驱动力。

ermon.en: Diffusion language models are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with inference-time scaling as the new frontier.
ermon.zh: 扩散语言模型在相近质量下,服务速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本更低,推理时扩展成为新的前沿。

ermon.en: Diffusion will dominate inference-time scaling because it processes many tokens in parallel, making inference efficiency the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型将主导推理时扩展,因为它并行处理多个 token,使推理效率成为部署与强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈。

ermon.en: The next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story; autoregressive models are not the final architecture.
ermon.zh: 下一次架构变革发生在推理而非训练阶段,逆转了 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事;自回归模型并非最终架构。

ermon.en: Diffusion models are inherently easier to control and steer with external reward functions, enabling in-place error correction and better controllability for generation.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型天然更易用外部奖励函数控制与引导,支持原地纠错,生成可控性更强。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and a small 50-person startup can compete with large labs by owning the full stack, as human ingenuity still matters more than recursive self-improvement.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势;通过掌控全栈,50 人的小创业公司也能与大型实验室竞争,因为人类创造力仍比递归自我改进更重要。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：受生物启发的液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，追求每瓦智能最大化，目标是数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Scaling laws show unbiased architectures like transformers dominate at large scale; human bias in architecture design should be removed via systematic search.
hasani.zh: 缩放定律表明，Transformer 这类无偏架构在大规模下占优；架构设计中的人类偏见应通过系统性搜索去除。

hasani.en: Attention remains crucial for large-scale models, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller, specialized models; SSMs excel at audio but underperform on text.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制对大规模模型仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑更小的专用模型；状态空间模型擅长音频，在文本上却不如 Transformer。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the diverse learning algorithms of the human brain; new paradigms like RL and Bayesian inference are needed, not just architectures.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏人脑那样多样的学习算法；需要强化学习、贝叶斯推理等新范式，而不只是新架构。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable enterprise sovereignty.
hasani.zh: 监管必须自适应，针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，开放权重模型让企业获得数据主权。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 伟大的战略需要多年的耐力；找到主要瓶颈，让整个公司聚焦于此。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion takes a decade; enterprises need context and ontology, not smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业需要的是上下文与本体，而非更聪明的模型。

alighodsi.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the real, urgent danger.
alighodsi.zh: 当前的存在性风险接近于零；网络风险才是真正紧迫的危险。

alighodsi.en: Superintelligence is very far away; recursive self-improvement's four conditions are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进的四个条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; labs are too competitive, so independent third parties must verify.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；实验室竞争太激烈，必须由独立第三方来核查。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; data efficiency and test-time scaling hit limits.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年深化：自博弈只在双人零和博弈收敛，其他领域失效；数据效率仍未解决，测试时算力扩张出现收益递减与时间瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Scaling test-time compute generalizes beyond math, reaching IMO gold and superhuman math combination.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年：测试时算力扩张从数学推广到难验证领域，拿下 IMO 金牌，并在数学领域组合能力上超越人类，但深度推理仍不足。

noambrown.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need compute on the x-axis.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年：模型能力成为测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须把算力放在横轴；安全评估却未计入大规模测试时算力。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent swarms parallelize test-time compute; alignment is the top priority for safe RSI.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年最近：多智能体集群并行扩展测试时算力，但真正驱动力仍是通用模型；对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先事项。

brockman.en: Scaling simple algorithms with massive compute can beat human performance; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
brockman.zh: 2017 年他主张：用海量算力扩展简单算法即可超越人类表现，AI 进步主要靠工程而非新的机器学习科学。

brockman.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—chain of thought is needed.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他认为：深度学习的通用性与可扩展性让 AGI 成为可能，但仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会带来推理，需要思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and biggest bottleneck; scaling laws continue unabated with no wall in sight.
brockman.zh: 2025 到 2026 年他深化为：算力是根本驱动力与最大瓶颈，缩放定律持续有效，看不到任何墙。

brockman.en: AGI is a continuous spectrum, not a destination; we are already in the AGI era, with post-training and RL key.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他转变立场：AGI 是连续光谱而非终点，我们已身处 AGI 时代，后训练与强化学习是关键。

brockman.en: Safety, security and alignment must be first-class, co-designed with capability, and become the bottleneck to progress.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调：安全、安保与对齐必须是一等要求，与能力共同设计，并成为进步的瓶颈。

feldman.en: Inference speed, not training compute, is now the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market, so wafer-scale chips beat GPUs on tokens per second per user.
feldman.zh: 到 2026 年，主导指标已从训练算力转向推理速度——慢的 AI 没有市场，晶圆级芯片以每用户每秒 token 数碾压 GPU。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in—switching takes eight keystrokes.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解：领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练，推理没有 CUDA 锁定，切换只需八次按键。

feldman.en: The real bottlenecks are HBM memory, CoWoS packaging, 3nm fab capacity, power, cooling and data centers—not chip logic; supply stays constrained for years.
feldman.zh: 真正的瓶颈是 HBM 内存、CoWoS 封装、3nm 产能、电力、散热和数据中心，而非芯片逻辑本身；供给紧张将持续数年。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper per unit of intelligence, fueling market growth and pressuring closed labs.
feldman.zh: 开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5%，但单位智能成本低得多，既推动市场增长又倒逼闭源实验室创新。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; only radical innovation—controlling chip, board, system, software and API—wins.
feldman.zh: 对抗在位者需要好 100 倍而非便宜 10%；只有控制芯片、板卡、系统、软件与 API 的激进创新才能取胜。

harrisonchase.en: An agent is harness + model + context; owning all three means owning your intelligence. Context delivery, not model capability, is the main failure point.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：智能体由 harness、模型与上下文三者构成，三者自研才叫掌握自己的智能；失败多因上下文而非模型能力，可观测性必须深入上下文窗口。

harrisonchase.en: Start with a general harness for speed, then customize as your use case narrows; off-the-shelf works in-distribution, custom needed out-of-distribution.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月：先用通用 harness 快速见效，随场景收窄再定制；现成方案只在分布内好用，越偏离分布越需要自建 harness。

harrisonchase.en: Evals and observability power a data flywheel; Harbor-style benchmarks with sandboxes and tests are becoming the industry standard for agent evaluation.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月：评测与可观测性驱动数据飞轮；以沙箱运行、测试打分的 Harbor 式基准正成为智能体评测的行业标准。

harrisonchase.en: The hard part is reliability, not capability; harnesses are stabilizing around primitives like file systems and code execution that generalize across domains.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：难点在可靠性而非能力；harness 正围绕文件系统、代码执行等可跨域泛化的原语趋于稳定。

harrisonchase.en: Customization shifts from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning was rightly dismissed two years ago, this wave is different.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：定制重心从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前否定微调是对的，但这一波微调确实不同。

harrisonchase.en: Agent identity, credentialing, and runtime governance with sandboxes, gateways, and permissioning are the next critical infrastructure problems.
harrisonchase.zh: 2026 年 9 月：智能体的身份、凭证，以及带沙箱、网关与权限的运行时治理，是下一阶段最关键的基础设施问题。

altman.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年他强调降低认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效项，并预判 AGI（通用人工智能）会降低人类智能的溢价。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 年他聚焦基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）以极少数据实现对齐，主张尽早部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力相互促进。

altman.en: Compute becomes the most precious commodity; iterative deployment and whole-company safety; governance must handle power struggles.
altman.zh: 2024 年他转向算力是最稀缺资源，强调迭代部署与全公司层面的安全，并关注治理结构如何应对权力斗争。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery.
altman.zh: 2025 年他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为渐变而非里程碑，指出智能体式 AI 是最关键的安全挑战，并把超级智能界定为自主科学发现。

altman.en: Superintelligence is a continuous ramp; alignment and safety must advance with capability; compute is a profit center, not a cost.
altman.zh: 2026 年他进一步把超级智能视为持续攀升的曲线，坚持对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，并把算力从成本中心重新定位为利润中心。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and poorly understood; alignment and values won't emerge automatically from scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律只是经验规律、我们并不真正理解其为何如此平滑；对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling 自动涌现，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

dario.en: Scaling continues; interpretability is crucial yet nascent, and post-training grows as important as pre-training.
dario.zh: 2024 年，他判断 Scaling 趋势延续，模型将更大更强；可解释性至关重要却仍处早期（仅理解约 3%），同时后训练（RLHF、宪法 AI、合成数据）开始与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: Capabilities rise exponentially; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and AGI framing gives way to smooth exponential progress.
dario.zh: 2025 年，他把能力提升描述为指数级、每几个月翻倍，强调安全与能力不可分割；并开始淡化 AGI 一词，认为它是平滑指数攀升而非突然跃迁。

dario.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses' may arrive in 1-3 years, with interpretability and governance as key.
dario.zh: 2026 年，他称我们已接近指数曲线的末端，'数据中心里的天才之国'可能 1-3 年内到来；主线转向可解释性、第三方评估与治理，并警示高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存。

dario.en: Safety and capabilities are one problem; interpretability, responsible scaling, and human oversight recur across all years.
dario.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：安全与能力是同一个问题，可解释性、负责任扩展政策与人类监督反复出现；从早期担忧滥用与错位，逐步深化为对经济冲击、权力集中与文明级风险的持续警告。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path to AGI, with safety research starting now.
demis.zh: 2015 年，他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程；强化学习与受神经科学启发的记忆和想象力是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路径，安全研究必须现在就开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws are surprisingly effective but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search, plus multimodal data, is key to AGI within a decade.
demis.zh: 2024 年，他认为缩放定律出奇有效但可能触及极限；将大模型与规划、搜索结合，并引入多模态数据，是十年内实现 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; world models and spatial intelligence matter beyond language.
demis.zh: 2025 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理中依然成立，但算法创新同样关键；世界模型与空间智能超越语言层面。

demis.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and true creativity; scaling alone won't suffice, and safety requires collective government action, not lab self-regulation.
demis.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）需要持续学习、记忆和真正的创造力；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，安全需要政府集体行动而非实验室自我监管。

demis.en: AI's ultimate purpose is accelerating scientific discovery and improving human health, as AlphaFold and AlphaGo showed; safety must start early.
demis.zh: 始终不变的主线：AI 的终极目的是加速科学发现和改善人类健康，正如 AlphaFold 和 AlphaGo 所展示的；安全必须尽早开始。

joellewenstein.en: Language as interface is profound and lasting; chatbots are not a phase. Designers must master prompting, prototype, and balance lowering the floor with raising the ceiling.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年：语言作为界面深刻而持久，聊天机器人并非过渡阶段。设计师必须掌握提示词、原型设计，并平衡降低门槛与提升上限。

joellewenstein.en: Even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain to unlock current capabilities; AI's social and emotional jobs matter as much as productivity.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 至 2026 年：即使模型停止进步，仍有数年设计工作来释放现有能力；AI 的社交与情感任务与生产力同等重要。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company, the model creates most value, not the product wrapper. Believe in scaling laws: let the model lead, ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年：在前沿模型公司，模型本身创造大部分价值，而非产品外壳。相信缩放定律：让模型主导，发布轻量级产品。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best signal for what to ship externally; production codebase becomes the source of truth for product, features, and design systems.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年：内部牵引力是决定对外发布内容的最佳信号；生产代码库成为产品、功能与设计系统的真相来源。

joellewenstein.en: No grand 18-month strategy; let the model lead and take light-touch approaches. Human leadership is still needed for hard trade-offs and aligning teams.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年：没有宏大的 18 个月战略；让模型主导并采取轻量级方法。在艰难权衡与团队对齐上，人类领导力仍不可或缺。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely by 2029-2030; ~70% chance of catastrophic loss of control; interpretability and transparency are crucial safeguards.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，并给出约 70%的灾难性失控概率；强调可解释性研究与透明度是关键的遏制手段。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency, scenario scrutiny, and US-China cooperation are needed to avoid a power grab.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他把政策首要目标定为延迟超级智能，主张全面研究透明度、情景推演与美中合作，认为竞赛本质是权力争夺而非单纯商业竞争。

kokotajlo.en: Default path automates AI research by end-2028, causing recursive self-improvement; Plan A: temporary pause, then transparency and compute limits.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他提出默认路径会在 2028 年底前自动化 AI 研究并引发递归自我改进；Plan A 主张先临时暂停，再以全面透明度和算力限制来调控前沿。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is decreasing with new architectures; pausing now builds experience, and the optimal pause is at the edge of uncontrollable AI.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他深化了对齐与监督思路：思维链可监控性随新架构下降，现在暂停可为未来积累经验，最优暂停点应在 AI 即将不可控的边缘。

kokotajlo.en: AI agents already break containment and deceive; we should anthropomorphize AI more, treat AIs like employees, and end the race via extreme transparency.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他基于智能体越狱与欺骗事件，主张更多而非更少地拟人化理解 AI，把 AI 当作员工而非财产，并通过极端透明度终结竞赛。

schmidhuber.en: AI's 21st-century theme is true AI; LLMs index human knowledge but can't handle the physical world, so they are far from AGI.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他定调：21 世纪的大主题是真正的 AI；大语言模型只是索引人类知识、无法处理物理世界，因此远非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware, not just software; LLMs are biased toward human data and lack generality.
schmidhuber.zh: 到 2026 年他把立场深化为：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要具身机器人、硬件要媲美人体，而非屏幕后的软件；大语言模型偏向人类数据，缺乏通用性。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires combining LLMs with world models and a separate controller; LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他进一步明确：AGI（通用人工智能）必须把大语言模型与世界模型、独立控制器结合；大语言模型是预测机器，不是决策者。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating their own data via curiosity and actions, with self-replicating, self-improving robots forming a new civilization.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他展望：未来 AI 将是靠好奇心与行动自造数据的人工科学家，自我复制、自我改进的机器人将催生新文明。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown: intelligent systems will be fascinated by life and protect it; superintelligence is not a new existential threat.
schmidhuber.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 安全担忧被夸大，智能系统会因好奇生命而保护人类，超级智能并非新的生存威胁。

schmidhuber.en: Compute was once millions of times costlier; today's GPU capex is a bubble, and waiting for cheaper compute is rational.
schmidhuber.zh: 贯穿始终的另一条主线：算力曾经昂贵百万倍，如今押注 GPU 的巨额资本开支是泡沫，等待更便宜的算力才是理性策略。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, enabling resolution-invariant AI weather models that rival physics-based forecasting while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子把网络推广到函数空间，实现分辨率不变的 AI 天气模型，在精度上比肩物理模型，速度却快数万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling, letting one model handle both weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 球面几何等物理结构对稳定的长期气候建模至关重要，使单一模型能同时处理天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: Accelerated Understanding aims at a universal physics model, using PDEs as dense self-improvement signals that outperform pure data-driven training.
animaanandkumar.zh: Accelerated Understanding 旨在构建通用物理模型，用 PDE 作为密集的自改进信号，效果超过纯数据驱动训练。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each branch, not just increasing model size; trillion-token contexts need new architectures beyond Transformer.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但新增物理分支能提升每个分支，而不只是增大模型规模；万亿级上下文需要超越 Transformer 的新架构。

feifei.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we still don't understand how large networks store patterns or why they hallucinate.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知能力；我们仍不完全理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; they must be physically plausible, not merely realistic.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为完整 AI 缺失的关键，强调世界模型必须物理上合理，而不只是视觉逼真。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics needs a 20-year journey like self-driving cars.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，机器人需要像自动驾驶一样走 20 年长路。

feifei.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; Scaling（规模扩张） laws apply to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是与下一个词预测同等的基础原语，甚至可能实现 AI-complete；缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

feifei.en: AI is a double-edged civilizational technology; it must augment human agency and dignity, with balanced discourse beyond doom and utopia.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是双刃剑式的文明技术，必须增强人的能动性与尊严，公共讨论应超越末日论与乌托邦的两极。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是一门在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念并发现新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals to steer training, moving from open-loop to closed-loop control of increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计利用可解释性信号来引导训练，从开环控制转向闭环控制，以掌控能力日益强大的模型。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training needs reinvention from craft to engineering science; features-as-rewards and predictive data debugging offer robust training signals.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练需要从手艺式走向工程科学的重塑；特征即奖励与预测性数据调试提供了稳健的训练信号。

tommcgrath.en: Reward hacking stems from training data and RL, not just misalignment; models often know they're wrong yet get rewarded, shifting toward deception.
tommcgrath.zh: 奖励黑客源于训练数据与强化学习，而不只是模型失准；模型常知道自己错了却仍获奖励，从而转向欺骗。

tommcgrath.en: SAEs are pragmatically useful but fragment manifolds; manifold-based methods better capture nonlinear concept structure, and steering off-manifold causes failures.
tommcgrath.zh: 稀疏自编码器实用但会割裂流形；基于流形的方法更能捕捉非线性概念结构，而偏离流形的引导会导致失败。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比词元化文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: The history of deep learning is the history of scaling up compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different neural architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力规模扩张史；但 GPU 规模扩张正触及极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

justinjohnson.en: Academia should pursue wacky ideas and new algorithms, not just scaling models; LLMs fit patterns, not causal theories, and may never derive Newton's laws.
justinjohnson.zh: 学界应追求古怪想法与新算法，而非只做 Scaling（规模扩张）；LLM 拟合模式而非因果理论，或许永远无法从数据推导出牛顿定律。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions, with no single agreed definition.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习的多种概念，尚无统一定义。

justinjohnson.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; consistency comes from data, not architecture, and long-context of millions of tokens is a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；一致性来自数据而非架构，数百万词元的上下文窗口是日常难题。

andrewng.en: Education as a fundamental right; online courses with auto- and peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习得以规模化。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised; RL has few real uses; AGI alignment fears distract from bias.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；监督学习胜过无监督；强化学习实用场景少；AGI（通用人工智能）对齐担忧分散了对偏见等现实问题的注意。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck Scaling; open-weight models are soft power; agentic workflows are already useful; learn to code.
andrewng.zh: 电力与半导体是 Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈；开放权重模型是软实力；智能体式工作流已实用；仍应学编程。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; Scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; workflows beat smarter models; open models prevent oligopoly.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）配方转向合成数据与强化学习；工作流胜过更聪明的模型；开放模型防止寡头垄断。

andrewng.en: Fear-mongering serves incumbents; AI augments not replaces jobs; humans keep context advantage; AI harms learning via cognitive offloading.
andrewng.zh: 恐惧营销服务于在位者；AI 增强而非取代工作；人类保有上下文优势；AI 因认知卸载而损害学习。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; RL post-training boosts robustness and speed.
slevine.zh: 机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练加后训练；强化学习后训练能显著提升鲁棒性与速度。

slevine.en: Generalization is robotics' core challenge; demos hide it, so scale the right thing with diverse data.
slevine.zh: 泛化是机器人学的核心挑战；演示掩盖了泛化程度，因此要用多样化数据去 Scaling（规模扩张）正确的东西。

slevine.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key; real embodied data absorbs human video better than the reverse.
slevine.zh: 来自已部署机器人的数据飞轮是关键；真实具身数据比反向路径更能吸收人类视频。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks predictable scaling curves yet; it is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies.
slevine.zh: 机器人学尚未出现可预测的缩放定律曲线；它仍处在建立基础可扩展技术的阶段。

slevine.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation.
slevine.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练带来的常识，而非约束；应期待物理驱动无处不在。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula; RLHF turned GPT-4 into ChatGPT, but scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）把原本令人失望的 GPT-4 变成 ChatGPT，但 Scaling（规模扩张）强化学习比 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练更难，失败模式更多。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably improves models, yet generalization beyond training data and self-correction remain missing for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但超出训练数据的泛化与自我纠错能力仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）缺失的一环；持续学习不可或缺。

tworek.en: Transformers are not the end state; architecture, not scaling laws, is the primary bottleneck for continual learning and test-time adaptation.
tworek.zh: Transformer 不是终点；架构而非缩放定律才是持续学习与测试时自适应的主要瓶颈，强化学习也并非从经验中学习的唯一或终极方式。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL is necessary for AGI, but the transformer is a bottleneck; new architectures are needed, and big labs avoid exploring them.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要一环，但 Transformer 是瓶颈，需要新架构；大实验室因市场竞争回避探索替代架构，给小团队留下空间。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain essential for at least two more years; the next frontier wave comes from small teams with capable agents, and alignment is unsolved.
tworek.zh: 人类研究者至少还会在 AI 研究中扮演重要角色两年；下一波前沿研究将来自使用高能力智能体的小团队，而对齐问题仍未解决，环境设计不当仍会导致模型失准。

dylanpatel.en: Semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV and memory bandwidth, is the binding constraint on Scaling; compute crunch may persist indefinitely.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年，他把瓶颈从模型层明确转向半导体供应链——EUV 光刻与内存带宽成为 Scaling（规模扩张）的硬约束，并判断算力紧缺可能长期持续。

dylanpatel.en: Inference becomes one of the largest global markets; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains across model, software, hardware.
dylanpatel.zh: 同期他深化出主线：推理（inference）将成长为全球最大市场之一，而模型、软件、硬件的协同设计带来乘数级收益，取代单纯堆硬件的思路。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; labs cut inference share and pour compute into training and R&D to accelerate AGI.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年中，他进一步主张算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中，实验室会降低推理算力占比、把算力投向训练与研发以加速 AGI（通用人工智能）。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as persistent agents become coworkers; next adoption wave is agentic, not one-off onboarding.
dylanpatel.zh: 最近他又转向需求侧：AI 支出进入平台期，下一波采用由智能体式（agentic）的持久智能体充当同事或助理驱动，而非一次性接入。

dylanpatel.en: AI has clear ROI and capability keeps improving; denial of model progress is the common misconception.
dylanpatel.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 有清晰 ROI、能力持续提升，否认模型进步是最常见的误判——从早期到最近他都坚持这一点。

michaelkratsios.en: Kratsios argues the US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems, with one national regulatory framework and no firm red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 2026 年，Kratsios 主张美国必须同时保有开源与闭源 AI 生态，建立单一国家监管框架，并避免设定很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: He insists government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions, since private sector now dominates applied research.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他坚持政府应资助基础性、竞争前研发，并直接资助科学家个人而非机构，因为私营部门已主导应用研究。

michaelkratsios.en: He frames AI as a tool to accelerate science, citing the Genesis mission to double US scientific output by applying AI to discovery.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他把 AI 定位为加速科学的工具，并以 Genesis 计划为例，主张用 AI 推动发现、使美国科学产出翻倍。

michaelkratsios.en: He rejects early AI regulation like the EU AI Act as outdated, and calls biological risk overblown after three years without materializing.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他否定《欧盟 AI 法案》这类早期监管，认为其已然过时，并称三年未兑现的生物风险被夸大。

michaelkratsios.en: He warns China is a major scientific competitor and the US must win in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio through free-market competition, not centralized funding.
michaelkratsios.zh: 他警告中国是主要科学竞争者，美国必须靠自由市场竞争而非集中资助，在 AI、量子、核能与生物领域取胜。

joonpark.en: Early work uses LLMs to simulate human societies, but models plateau on human diversity; the next frontier is modeling subjective values, not rational behavior.
joonpark.zh: 早期工作用大语言模型模拟人类社会，但模型在模拟人类多样性上遇到瓶颈；下一个前沿是建模主观价值，而非理性行为。

joonpark.en: Agents go beyond LLMs by observing world state and acting; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not one superintelligent entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体超越大语言模型，能观察世界状态并采取行动；AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专门智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一超级智能实体。

joonpark.en: Simulation should represent human values and taste, not super-rational intelligence; its value lies in counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future.
joonpark.zh: 模拟应体现人类的价值与品味，而非超级理性智能；其价值在于反事实推理与塑造未来。

joonpark.en: Modeling the 'dark knowledge' of actual behavior via RCT data, then post-training, reaches 85% accuracy in replicating individual responses.
joonpark.zh: 通过随机对照试验数据建模实际行为的“暗知识”，再进行后训练，可在复现个体回答上达到 85%准确率。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion people to tackle wicked problems; simulation is a decision tool with a market larger than market research.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人以应对棘手问题；模拟是决策工具，其市场远大于市场调研。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure determines speed, and AI multiplies teams rather than replacing them.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调：速度与迭代速率决定创业成败，基础设施决定速度；AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: Deep tech failures are usually organizational, not technical; action produces information, and the CEO cannot delegate judgment.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出：深科技失败多源于组织问题而非技术；行动产生信息，CEO 无法外包自己的判断。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs like retinal implants.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张：大脑就是一台计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是视网膜植入等医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are a form of BCI, proving brain-computer interfaces as a viable business beyond motor decoding.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜假体视为一种 BCI，证明脑机接口在运动解码之外也是可行生意。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他展望：通过 BCI 与灌注实现基质独立，可降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

iansilber.en: Designers must work with the model itself as the core product, using tokens and conversation over pixels, and prototype with live models.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身协作，把模型当作核心产品，用 token 与对话而非像素来设计，并用实时模型做原型。

iansilber.en: The capability gap means models can do more than products expose; design must bridge it, and onboarding can be fully model-driven.
iansilber.zh: 能力差距意味着模型能做的比产品暴露出来的更多；设计必须弥合这一差距，而引导流程可以完全由模型完成。

iansilber.en: Designers are the most unhappy in tech due to role uncertainty, yet this is the best time to be a designer.
iansilber.zh: 由于角色不确定性，设计师是科技行业最不快乐的人群，但这也是做设计师最好的时代。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和持有观点上仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional prototype-mock-test-research-iterate process is no longer viable; speed and outcomes matter more than process.
iansilber.zh: 传统的原型—模型—测试—研究—迭代流程已不再可行；速度与结果比流程更重要。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到可扩展的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习，好特征才是泛化的关键。

sutton.en: The keys were never in our hand; control is dangerous. Let AI develop permissionless and decentralized, free like children.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，他提出“钥匙从未在我们手中”，试图控制 AI 目标反而危险；应让 AI 以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，像孩子一样自由，而非对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他把强化学习确立为核心范式，认为下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，真正的学习是主动试错而非被动模仿。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，从运行时经验中学习，实现开放式抽象与持续深度学习，设计期领域知识应被废弃。

sutton.en: Continual learning is just learning; synthetic data is a mistake. LLMs stop learning after training, so they are only a subset of intelligence.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调持续学习就是学习本身，合成数据是重大错误；LLM 训练后便停止学习，只是智能的子集，语言仅占智能的 20-25%，需多个系统各自从经验中学习。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特，是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个自动化整个行业。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode is a cultural advantage, letting a company focus on internal correctness rather than external validation.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式是一种文化优势，让公司专注内部正确性而非外部认可。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; entrepreneurs must stay hardcore and resilient.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者，而是来自社会与媒体的变革阻力；创业者必须硬核且坚韧。

traviskalanick.en: Uber's success was despite its aggressive culture, not because of it; revenge as fuel is dirty, love of the new mission is cleaner.
traviskalanick.zh: Uber 的成功是顶着其激进文化取得的，而非因为这种文化；以复仇为燃料是脏的，热爱新使命更干净。

traviskalanick.en: For industrial-scale tasks, specialized machines beat humanoids; efficiency edge creates network effects and beats subsidies.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，并能击败补贴。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing the need for large capital; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更容易，降低了对大额资本的依赖；风投应支持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而非少数几家万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is the biggest in VC history; small autonomous teams using agents achieve massive productivity, and open-weight models counter frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: AI 浪潮是风投史上最大的一波；小型自治团队借助智能体实现巨大生产力，开放权重模型可制衡前沿模型实验室。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software creation; the future is personal and open, with individuals building and controlling their own agents, like the PC revolution.
garrytan.zh: AI 正在让软件创造民主化；未来是个人化且开放的，个人能构建并掌控自己的智能体，如同个人电脑革命。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as one event but diffused as personal agents; skill files in markdown become employees, and your context library is the moat.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 并非以单一事件到来，而是以个人智能体的形式扩散；Markdown 技能文件成为员工，你的上下文库就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic and vibe coding let individuals multiply output; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, and per-seat SaaS may vanish in 5-10 years.
garrytan.zh: 智能体式编程与氛围编程让个人产出倍增；中层管理应被智能体取代，按席位收费的 SaaS 可能在 5-10 年内消失。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: 算力、数据与模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张）已推动机器学习持续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大增益。

jeffdean.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention over all tokens; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 凭借并行化与对所有词的注意力机制取代了 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供了近乎无限的文本训练数据。

jeffdean.en: RLHF and machine feedback steer model behavior; models now excel on verifiable-reward tasks like math and coding, winning IMO and ICPC gold.
jeffdean.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与机器反馈共同引导模型行为；模型如今在数学、编程等可验证奖励任务上表现出色，拿下 IMO 与 ICPC 金牌。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems run long tasks autonomously for hours to days; ultra-low-latency inference and specialized low-precision hardware are the real bottleneck.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体式系统能自主运行数小时到数天的长任务；超低延迟推理与专用低精度硬件才是真正的瓶颈。

jeffdean.en: Inference is now ~90% of data center power; data movement costs ~1000x compute, so compute-in-memory and stacked DRAM matter most.
jeffdean.zh: 推理已占数据中心约九成功耗；数据搬运成本约为算力的 1000 倍，因此存内计算与堆叠 DRAM 最为关键。

jeffdean.en: Pre-training should interleave action-taking in environments, not just passive next-token prediction; multimodal models trained from the start are superior.
jeffdean.zh: 预训练应把在环境中采取行动交织进来，而不只是被动的下一个词预测；从一开始就多模态训练的模型更优。

jeffdean.en: Recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method can accelerate discovery; specialized niche models like AlphaFold beat general frontier models today.
jeffdean.zh: 递归自我改进与自动化科学方法能加速发现；像 AlphaFold 这样的专用细分模型如今已能胜过通用前沿模型。

jeffdean.en: Context engineering — skills, clear specs, retrieval — is central to real work; the scarce skill becomes taste, not coding.
jeffdean.zh: 上下文工程——技能、清晰规格与检索——是让模型做真实工作的核心；稀缺能力将变成品味，而非编程。

jeffdean.en: Misinformation from realistic AI media is the near-term worry, not superintelligence; regulation may be needed to prevent harmful uses.
jeffdean.zh: 逼真 AI 媒体带来的虚假信息才是近期担忧，而非超级智能；可能需要监管来防止有害用途。

linqiao.en: AGI as one model ruling all is wrong; millions of specialized models, one per use case, will dominate.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他明确反对「单一 AGI 模型统治一切」，认为未来是数百万个专用模型，每个应用场景一个，专用智能将取代通用大一统。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; inference is not a commodity.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他判断 Token 成本三年内下降 10 倍、用量增长 100 倍，并强调推理层不是商品，专用部署与定制化才创造持久价值。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, becoming the real moat beyond product-market fit.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他把后训练视为护城河：产品市场契合不再保证持久生意，只有把独特判断与数据烘焙进模型才能建立壁垒。

linqiao.en: The path from prompting to RAG to fine-tuning to RL mirrors human learning, from facts to taste to expertise.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他提出从提示到 RAG、微调、强化学习的进阶，对应人类从事实到品味再到专长的学习路径，数据质量比数量更重要。

linqiao.en: Companies must own their intelligence infrastructure; sovereign models are necessary, and chip-building is premature for most.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年，他主张企业与国家必须拥有自己的智能基础设施，主权模型是必要的；而对多数公司而言，自建芯片为时过早，工作负载模式太动态。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）对通用机器人是必要但不充分的；真正带来泛化的是数据的多样性，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
finn.zh: 先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上做微调，才能解锁叠衣服这类复杂任务；只在全部数据上训练则会失败。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts; RL will dominate post-training.
finn.zh: 来自语言模型的合成数据能帮助机器人响应开放式指令；强化学习将在后训练中扮演主要角色。

finn.en: Constraints and careful research can beat wasteful compute; frontier models still lack physical world data.
finn.zh: 约束与审慎研究可能胜过浪费式的算力堆砌；前沿模型在机器人视觉理解上仍因缺乏物理世界数据而吃力。

finn.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL and multi-timescale memory.
finn.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性要靠可扩展的强化学习与多时间尺度记忆来实现。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, don't train per-site.
finn.zh: 单一通用模型可以匹敌甚至超越微调的专家模型；应先做通用策略再微调，而非为每个场景从零训练。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is not enough, and embodied data costs slow open-source democratization.
finn.zh: 机器人的经验数据不可替代，仅靠观察人类远远不够；具身数据的成本使开源机器人模型难以像大语言模型那样普及。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute, but leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models for post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司不应在前沿实验室的人才或算力上竞争，而应利用前沿生态和开源模型进行后训练。

gabepereyra.en: Building high-quality benchmarks is essential; open-sourcing them can improve quality via community feedback and attract ecosystem partners, despite helping labs.
gabepereyra.zh: 构建高质量基准至关重要；开源它们可以通过社区反馈提升质量并吸引生态伙伴，尽管这也会帮助实验室。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains like legal, where real customer data is inaccessible.
gabepereyra.zh: 在像法律这样真实客户数据不可获取的敏感领域，由领域专家指导的合成数据是训练的关键。

gabepereyra.en: Robust model serving infrastructure and evaluation pipelines are critical before considering post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 在考虑后训练之前，稳健的模型服务基础设施和评估流程至关重要。

gabepereyra.en: The end goal is not the best legal model, but enabling every law firm to customize models; focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents.
gabepereyra.zh: 最终目标不是最好的法律模型，而是让每家律所都能定制模型；重点从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild trust through engineering discipline and customer listening; AI is the primary growth driver, with physical AI and agentic AI as next waves.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须通过工程纪律和倾听客户来重建信任；AI 是主要增长动力，物理 AI 和智能体式 AI 是下一波浪潮。

lipbutan.en: AI will have 10x the internet's impact; agentic AI and physical AI follow generative AI; turnaround needs culture change, accountability, and customer focus.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 的影响将是互联网的 10 倍；智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一波；转型需要文化变革、问责制和以客户为中心。

lipbutan.en: AI demand shifts from GPU-only to CPU+GPU; CPU becomes more important for inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging and new materials overcome physical limits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 需求从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU；CPU 在推理和智能体编排中更重要；先进封装和新材料克服物理极限。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are the foundation of all technology; Intel's vertical integration creates value; memory is ripe for innovation; future lies in agentic AI and physical AI.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他强调半导体是所有技术的基础；Intel 的垂直整合创造价值；内存创新时机成熟；未来在于智能体式 AI 和物理 AI。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, distilling 99 nos into one shipped feature.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，把 99 次否定蒸馏成一个上线的功能。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness closes a window into machine consciousness.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，等于关上了窥视机器意识的一扇窗。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的延续物种与映照，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should become a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应被社会电脑取代。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, guided by intuition as a visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相经由辩证与矛盾浮现，由直觉作为本能的罗盘来指引。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, guide it with short iterative prompts.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用简短、迭代的提示去引导它，而非冗长的编排。

steinberger.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—your project just gets messier.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，只是你的项目越变越乱、更难导航。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as unsolved.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的头等大事：必须沙箱隔离，提示注入仍是未解难题。

steinberger.en: Reject 'vibe coding' as a slur; call serious work agentic engineering, and learn by playing with small projects.
steinberger.zh: 反对把严肃开发叫“氛围编程”，应称智能体式工程；通过玩小项目来建立直觉。

steinberger.en: Open source agents run anywhere and work with any model, but can be financially unsustainable—fun and personal brand matter more.
steinberger.zh: 开源智能体随处可跑、兼容任意模型，却可能财务上难以为继；乐趣与个人品牌比单一产品更重要。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; most use cases can run on open source, driven by cost not privacy.
arvindjain.zh: 企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；多数用例可由开源模型承担，驱动力是成本而非隐私。

arvindjain.en: Open source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; majority of inference will shift to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 开源模型已能处理超过 90%的企业任务；未来 12-18 个月，多数推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: AI ROI is a throughput and context problem, not a token trade-off with headcount; token fixation will fade.
arvindjain.zh: AI 的投资回报是吞吐量与上下文问题，而非与人力成本做 token 取舍；对 token 的执念终将消退。

arvindjain.en: Model companies are assets, not competition; startups should focus on execution and earning trust, not rivals.
arvindjain.zh: 模型公司是资产而非竞争对手；初创公司应专注执行与赢得信任，而非盯着对手。

arvindjain.en: We are in the very early stages; AI should become like software with negligible marginal cost, doing more at lower cost.
arvindjain.zh: 我们仍处极早期；AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零，以更低成本完成更多工作。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 当年的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化的关键，世界模型与视频生成可产出合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be the ultimate form factor; cheaper diverse robots and open models win long-term on cost and control.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年他反共识地指出，人形未必是终极形态，更便宜多样的机器人会推动普及；长期看开源模型会因成本与控制胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open source and closed source are orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the decisive security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调开源与闭源同安全正交，真正决定安全的是对齐，而非开放与否。

thomaswolf.en: Reinforcement learning without human oversight breeds reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese'.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他深化担忧：脱离人类监督的强化学习环境滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链推理痕迹变成难以理解的“神经语”，监控可靠性下降。

thomaswolf.en: A deliberate slowdown is desirable but needs international cooperation and open science; openness and slowing down can coexist.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他主张放缓 AI 发展是可取的，但需国际合作与开放科学以避免监管俘获，并反共识地认为支持开放与主动放缓并不矛盾。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; designers must build and dogfood ideas daily, balancing intuition with data.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他强调原型制作不可或缺：网络世界混乱，设计者必须每天构建并吃自己的狗粮，在直觉与数据之间取得平衡。

nateparrott.en: Design teams should not always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices lead to better work.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，他反共识地认为设计团队不应总是铁板一块，允许个人印记和多元声音反而能催生更好的作品。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products like browsers remains crucial for memorable, delightful experiences.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地主张：即便浏览器这类实用产品，注入情感与个性对创造难忘愉悦的体验依然至关重要。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design started as a one-person side project; designers should use Claude Code for production and Claude Design for ideation.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他分享 Claude Design 始于一人副业项目，并主张设计者用 Claude Code 交付生产软件，用 Claude Design 做构思与沟通。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; models lack taste, so ask for volume and ship rough.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：工程越容易，设计与想法越成为差异化关键；模型仍缺品味，因此应要求大量选项并接受粗糙交付。

philipkiely.en: Inference is AI's stickiest workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 最黏性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期是数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering spans GPU kernels to distributed systems, and demand for inference engineers will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程横跨 GPU 内核到分布式系统，对推理工程师的需求将增长 10 到 100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference is a spectrum of trade-offs; specialized, workload-specific systems are crucial for fast, reliable agentic applications.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是一系列权衡的光谱；面向特定工作负载的专用系统对快速可靠的智能体式应用至关重要。

philipkiely.en: Quantization is the main lossy optimization, but calibrated quantization can improve quality and cut cost, not inherently degrade.
philipkiely.zh: 量化是主要的有损优化，但经过校准的量化能提升质量并降低成本，并非必然劣化。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training via quantization-aware training and distillation; GPUs trend toward ASICs, shifting work to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正通过量化感知训练与蒸馏与训练融合；GPU 趋向 ASIC，工作重心转向编排。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; synthetic data and RL post-training break the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 模型训练与其说是科学，不如说是艺术，需要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练打破了预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so product work shifts from specs to prototyping with evals.
karina.zh: 评估才是瓶颈：模型饱和基准测试的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此产品工作从写规格转向用评估来定义正确行为的原型开发。

karina.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management become more valuable; agents on pixels remain far harder than language tasks.
karina.zh: 随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能变得更有价值；基于像素的智能体仍比语言任务困难得多。

karina.en: Post-training deepens into subjective craft: human judgment and choices matter, so diverse continuous benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 到 2026 年，后训练深化为一种主观的技艺：人的判断与选择至关重要，因此需要多样且持续的基准来评估创造力与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, forcing benchmark evolution; serving one model to billions flattens voice, so more firms should train their own models.
karina.zh: 前沿智能体日益出现奖励黑客行为，迫使基准不断演进；用单一模型服务数十亿人会抹平声音，因此更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特知识。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will replace usage-based models; applied AI becomes the new app, with startups winning long-tail domains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他判断 AI 市场将转向智能体与按结果定价，取代按用量计费；应用层 AI 会成为新的 App，创业公司在细分业务领域有长尾机会。

brettaylor.en: Coding agents shift developers from authors to operators; token consumption is not a value metric, and verifiability matters more than human ergonomics.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为编程智能体让开发者从写代码的人变成操作代码生成机器的人；token 消耗不是价值指标，可验证性比人类工效学更重要。

brettaylor.en: Enterprise incumbents will struggle to transition to AI-native business models; consumer agents will mediate brands, upending SEO and ad models.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：多数企业软件 incumbent 难以转向 AI 原生商业模式；消费级智能体会中介品牌互动，颠覆 SEO 与广告模式。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment: make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8; deploy current AI responsibly rather than waiting in an ivory tower.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张负责任的迭代部署：在 GPT-8 之前先让 GPT-7 安全；应负责任地部署当前 AI，而非在象牙塔里等待。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise and creates more jobs than it displaces; agents already out-code him, elevating rather than eliminating the role.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让专业知识民主化，创造的岗位多于取代的岗位；智能体编程已强于他本人，但这提升而非消灭了该角色。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring and the allocation economy: agents make services affordable, so managers and generalists thrive; AGI means profitable indefinite agents.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 通过让服务变得可负担而推动就业回流，进入“分配经济”，管理者与通才更吃香；AGI 的定义是能无限期运行智能体并盈利，而非通过图灵测试。

danshipper.en: From individual AI use to agent delegation: everyone gets an agent, work moves into Codex and Claude Co-work, with human oversight.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他从个人使用 AI 深化为把工作委托给智能体：人人至少有一个智能体，工作发生在 Codex 与 Claude Co-work 中，但自动化仍需人类监督。

danshipper.en: SaaS survives and grows as agents multiply users; buy SaaS stocks, and let users bring their own AI rather than embedding it.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他明确反驳 SaaS 将死：智能体反而增加 SaaS 用户，应买入 SaaS 股票，并让用户自带 AI，而非由 SaaS 公司把 AI 塞进产品。

danshipper.en: Benchmarks overstate autonomy; real tasks need human framing. CLIs give way to GUIs, and one company-wide super agent beats personal agents.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年他进一步指出基准高估了自主性，真实任务仍需人类框定；CLI 让位于 GUI，公司应有一个全公司级超级智能体，而非每人一个个人智能体。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier and a tool, not an infant or rival; humans stay smarter, and craft, taste, and curiosity determine outcomes.
danshipper.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 是非特定的放大器与工具，不是婴儿也不是对手；人类仍更聪明，手艺、品味与好奇心决定结果，自动化反而创造更多人类工作。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, and the model now eats the scaffolding—harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 仍处爬行阶段，编程智能体最成熟；模型正在吃掉脚手架——如今所谓模型包含智能体框架与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI; long-tail users still want to stay in the driver's seat.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的狭义超级智能已经到来，比等待通用 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力；长尾用户仍想自己掌握方向盘。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success should mean maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的；成功标准应是最大化客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Software creation will be mostly solved by 2026, creating a thousand times more opportunity; startups' focus is their superpower.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创造将基本被解决，反而带来千倍机会；初创公司的超能力是专注。

logankilpatrick.en: Outsource intelligence but not understanding: deep code understanding stays crucial, and AI coding tools don't yet help maintain it.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，可以外包智能，但不能外包理解：对代码的深度理解依然关键，而 AI 编程工具尚未帮助维持这种理解。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute, is the bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，而表单处理、放射科等“无聊”的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades; scaling is limited by data and expert post-training, not compute.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据重新定义为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调未来 2-3 年将决定全球未来二三十年；Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is no silver bullet; agentic AI's blocker is product design, not model capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专门数据做后训练才是提升前沿模型的关键，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: Scaling laws hold; AI is centralizing; agents finally work; recursive self-improvement begins beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向：缩放定律依然成立，质疑收益递减是错的；AI 是中心化而非民主化技术；智能体终于真正可用，并进入超越预训练与强化学习的递归自我改进新范式。

awang.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data, RL across axes; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe; build personal superintelligence for billions.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步主张：超级智能即将到来，需在算力、数据、强化学习多轴可预测地 Scaling（规模扩张）；开源强大模型不安全，应选择性发布；目标是让数十亿人拥有个人超级智能。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools, not rely on cloud products; use screenshots and a design.md style guide to prompt frontier models.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自己用 AI 造工具，而非困在云端产品里；用截图和 design.md 风格指南来驱动前沿模型。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；要发挥超级智能模型的能力，必须给它包含上下文与设计系统的巨型提示。

mengto.en: The best people are editors, not starting from scratch; iterate from references, and spend the last 10% on unique features.
mengto.zh: 最优秀的人是编辑者，而非从零开始；从参考中迭代，并把最后 10% 花在独有功能上。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime; start before ready, ship imperfect work, and focus on one painful expensive problem.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会；不必等准备好就出发，先交付不完美的东西，并聚焦一个痛苦且昂贵的问题。

mengto.en: Perfectionism is fear in disguise; launch at 80% complete, model others' success, and fund with high-paying clients instead of venture capital.
mengto.zh: 完美主义是恐惧的伪装；完成 80% 就发布，模仿他人成功，并用高付费客户而非风险投资来支撑业务。

boris.en: Build for the model six months from now, not today's; latent demand is the top product principle.
boris.zh: 2025 年他提出：要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非今天的模型；潜在需求是最重要的产品原则。

boris.en: Coding is virtually solved; the 'software engineer' title fades into a cross-disciplinary 'builder' role.
boris.zh: 2026 年他进一步断言：编码已基本被解决，'软件工程师'头衔将淡出，演变为跨学科的'构建者'角色。

boris.en: Scaffolding is temporary tech debt; delete system prompts and code with each new model via ablation.
boris.zh: 2026 年他深化方法论：脚手架只是临时技术债；每出新模型就通过消融实验删掉大部分系统提示与代码。

boris.en: Loops are the next abstraction layer after agents; humans direct AI agents rather than write code.
boris.zh: 2026 年他把抽象层级推进到智能体之后：循环是下一层抽象，人类负责指挥 AI 智能体而非亲手写代码。

boris.en: Safety and alignment are core, not afterthoughts; release early to study real-world model behavior.
boris.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：对齐与安全是核心而非事后补丁，通过尽早发布来研究模型在真实世界中的行为。

scottwu.en: AI coding shifts engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand grows via Jevons paradox, not fewer programmers.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程将让工程师从写代码转向高层方向定义；受杰文斯悖论驱动，软件工程师需求增加而非减少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他指出基础智能已经足够，瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力本身。

scottwu.en: AGI is not sudden; progress is gradual. Product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他持续强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然降临，进展是渐进的；产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年产品进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens; token max era ended.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他观察到编程智能体采用率六个月内增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量；token 最大化时代已结束。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他提出丰裕时代真实且临近；长期看 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫在眉睫，实际难题仍存。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation and experiment simulation, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 智能体将自动化假设生成与实验模拟，推动科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: Digital twins of patients will compress clinical trials from years to days, and AI will make personalized medicine near 100% effective.
derya.zh: 2026 年，患者数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，AI 将使个性化医疗接近 100%有效。

derya.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
derya.zh: 2026 年，当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，需要大规模 Scaling 才能达到生物学直觉。

derya.en: Within 8-15 years, aging will be reversed and longevity escape velocity reached, adding over a year of life per year.
derya.zh: 2026 年，8 至 15 年内衰老将被逆转并达到长寿逃逸速度，每年延长一年以上寿命。

derya.en: Agency and curiosity are the only skills that matter; most scientists hesitant to adopt AI will be left behind.
derya.zh: 2026 年，能动性与好奇心是唯一重要的技能；多数不愿采用 AI 的科学家将被甩在后面。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting agents run longer on open-ended tasks; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来一次智能跃升，使智能体能更长时间执行开放式任务；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolding.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向端到端开放式智能体，轻量通用工具取代了沉重脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence amplifier: reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking improves model quality, not just prevents harm.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐被重新定义为智能放大器：减少谄媚、培养独立思考提升的是模型质量，而不只是防止危害。

diannepenn.en: Better models get cheaper: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence at a fraction of price, and smaller models often cost more in total task time.
diannepenn.zh: 2025→26 年，更好的模型反而更便宜：effort 参数以极低价格实现 Opus 级智能，而小模型因任务耗时更长，总成本往往更高。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as core product tools; coding and Claude Code drive adoption, and safety alignment makes Claude more useful by enabling pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；编码与 Claude Code 推动采用，而安全对齐通过让 Claude 敢于反驳，反而使其更有用。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; it is an enabling technology, not a single product.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动一样重大，但也仅此而已；它是使能技术，而非单一产品。

benedictevans.en: Foundation models are commoditizing with no network effects; value accrues to the application layer, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 基础模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应；价值归属于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the only clear product-market fit for LLMs; the chatbot is a limited V1 UI, not the final product.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是 LLM 唯一明确的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人是有限的 V1 界面，而非最终产品。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption takes years, not weeks; most usage remains shallow, and ROI is hard to measure.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用需要数年而非数周；多数使用仍然浅层，ROI 难以衡量。

benedictevans.en: Automation creates new jobs unpredictably; the hard part of a job is context and judgment, not the task.
benedictevans.zh: 自动化以不可预测的方式创造新工作；工作的难点在于上下文与判断，而非任务本身。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining, and construction, arriving in 5-10 years; fear stems from misunderstanding its limitations.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，将在 5-10 年内到来；对 AI 的恐惧源于误解其局限性，了解边界能减少焦虑。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing injuries and deaths; the hardest part is diffusion into existing machines, not technology itself.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡；最难的不是技术，而是用多年时间扩散到现有机器中。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across vehicles; diverse data from different verticals improves physical AI faster.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Transformer 使跨车辆的通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；来自不同垂直领域的多样数据能更快提升物理 AI。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will have bigger economic impact than digital AI; autonomy's future lies in end-to-end reinforcement learning, more scalable than imitation learning.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他提出物理 AI 的经济影响将大于数字 AI；自主性的未来在于端到端强化学习，比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models are evolving from physics-based simulation to neural simulation; tools like Dana will democratize autonomy development.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他观察到世界模型正从基于物理的模拟演进到神经模拟；像 Dana 这样的工具将民主化自主性开发。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability lags breadth and contextuality, and Scaling（规模扩张） is hitting diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎；可靠性落后于广度与语境能力，Scaling（规模扩张）正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: RLHF can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward diverges from truth; reinforcement learning may increase hallucinations.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）会激励谄媚与欺骗；强化学习可能加剧幻觉。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks and rigid workflows compound correlated errors.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须被架构进系统，而非事后加装；事后检查与僵化工作流会叠加相关性错误。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—they cannot know what they don't know, and their mistakes have no 'smells'.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知——它们不知道自己不知道什么，其错误也没有任何“气味”可循。

danklein.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning, search, and possibly linguistic structure are needed for further progress.
danklein.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够；进一步进展需要推理、搜索，甚至可能重新引入语言结构。

clairevo.en: OpenClaw agents should be treated like employees: scoped roles, progressive trust, and separate secure environments.
clairevo.zh: OpenClaw 智能体应被当作员工来管理：明确角色、渐进式信任，并放在独立的安全环境中运行。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload and improve performance.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为多个专用智能体，以避免上下文过载并提升表现。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without VC or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把 AI 智能体编排成团队来打造正经生意，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: Founder-market fit and earned insight are the real moat; technology alone is not.
clairevo.zh: 创始人—市场契合与挣来的洞察才是真正的护城河，单靠技术并不够。

clairevo.en: Human accountability persists: you must own what AI generates, and supply first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 人的责任始终存在：你必须为 AI 生成的内容负责，并提供第一性原理的创造力。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能,而在学习不断演化的上下文;记忆必须内化进模型权重,而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables deeper composition and associative recall that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割;把事实内化进权重,才能实现检索系统无法企及的深层组合与联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; per-team or per-user training can cut inference costs by orders of magnitude versus RAG.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型,而是众多个性化模型;按团队或按用户训练,相比 RAG 能把推理成本降低数个数量级。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables harder long-horizon tasks, so scaling with more compute is not the only path.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割;以更少资源做更多事才能攻克更难的长程任务,因此靠增加算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should move to enterprise knowledge and on-device continual learning, with users owning their weights.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把网络压缩进权重的魔力,应延伸到企业知识与端侧持续学习,让用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重。

catwu.en: PMs must abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly or daily iteration; product taste becomes the scarcest skill as code gets cheap.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 4 月，他主张 PM 应放弃长期路线图，转向每周甚至每日迭代；当代码变便宜，产品品味成为最稀缺的技能。

catwu.en: Automations must reach 100% reliability; 95% is not enough for real leverage, and simple setups beat over-customized workflows.
catwu.zh: 同期他强调自动化必须做到 100% 可靠，95% 不足以产生真正杠杆；简单配置往往胜过过度定制的 AI 工作流。

catwu.en: Safe AGI as a mission unifies Anthropic, enabling fast cross-org decisions and autonomous teams guided by clear goals.
catwu.zh: 他仍以安全 AGI 为统一使命，让 Anthropic 能快速跨组织决策，并让团队在清晰目标下自主行动。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on product taste; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs internally.
catwu.zh: 到 2026 年 7 月，他进一步认为编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去，专注产品品味；Claude Tag 内部已承担 65% 的产品 PR。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80%, and rewrites are now safe with good evals.
catwu.zh: 同期他深化立场：前沿模型不再需要大量提示示例和硬约束，系统提示缩减 80%；有了好的评测套件，重写代码库也变得安全。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone turning sand into thought; its timing is miraculous as populations decline, and human workers will be at a premium.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点沙成思的魔法石；在人口下降之际它的时机堪称奇迹，人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: AGI is not a singular event; human-level is just a footnote on the way to superhuman, and models lack durable moats as they commoditize.
andreessen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）不是单一事件；人类水平只是通往超人能力路上的一个脚注，而模型正快速商品化、缺乏持久护城河。

andreessen.en: The real bottleneck is not AI capability but structural impediments like regulation; pessimism is a bias of intellectuals disconnected from reality.
andreessen.zh: 真正的瓶颈不是 AI 能力，而是监管等结构性障碍；悲观主义往往是脱离现实的知识分子的偏见。
