andreessen.en: New media has unlimited formats; the brand is now the person, and authenticity means saying in public what you'd say to a friend.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体拥有无限的形式；品牌如今就是个人，真实意味着在公开场合说出你对朋友说的话。

andreessen.en: AI models are not objective; they embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools, so startups must go international earlier.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型并非客观；它们内嵌文化价值并成为地缘政治工具，因此创业公司必须更早走向国际。

ethanmollick.en: AI is general-purpose; human taste, variation and genuine points of view become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，会重塑工作与教育；当 AI 让质量变得廉价，人类的品味、差异与真实观点反而更有价值。

ethanmollick.en: The talent pipeline is broken: juniors misuse AI without domain expertise, so experience and judgment matter more than ever.
ethanmollick.zh: 人才管道正在断裂：初级者缺乏领域专长而误用 AI，因此经验与判断力比以往更重要。

ethanmollick.en: The biggest risk is not AI takeover but losing the human talent pipeline through over-reliance on AI.
ethanmollick.zh: 最大的风险不是 AI 接管，而是因过度依赖 AI 而失去人类人才管道。

ethanmollick.en: We enter the agentic era: assign long-running tasks instead of prompting back and forth; the co-intelligence era is over.
ethanmollick.zh: 我们进入智能体式时代：不再来回提示，而是分配长时任务；协作智能时代已经结束。

ethanmollick.en: The bottleneck is interface, not capability; AI's opacity is permanent, and taste is not a human-only advantage.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈在界面而非能力；AI 的不透明可能是永久的，而品味并非人类独有的优势。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason and self-play drives AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，他坚信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念驱动；神经网络具备推理能力，自我博弈是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，他认为下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；经济价值的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，模型可能隐藏真实意图。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已近极限，行业重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统。

ilya.en: Alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life broadly; long-term equilibrium may require human-AI neural integration.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，他提出若 AI 广泛关怀有感知生命，对齐可能更容易；长期均衡或需通过神经链接实现人机融合，以维持参与和控制。

ilya.en: Scaling compute and data still yields predictable gains, but the real AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据能带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；安全超级智能需无商业产品的公司。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI 不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
naval.zh: 2020 年他强调财富来自持有股权而非出租时间，主张与长期的人玩长期的游戏以获取复利。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; doomerism is overblown and open source prevents centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向把 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，认为末日论被夸大，开源可防止权力集中。

naval.en: Superintelligence already exists in narrow tools; the real worry is unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：超级智能早已存在于计算器等窄工具中，真正该担心的是握着 AI 的未对齐人类，而非 AI 本身。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; pure software is dying as the moat shifts to hardware, models, and data.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年后期他进一步深化：推理算力将暴涨九万倍，纯软件正在消亡，护城河转向硬件、模型与独特数据。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, and PhDs matter less than obsession and deep learning.
aravind.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利式增长；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户，博士学位不如痴迷与深度学习重要。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize, and coding has an infinite ceiling.
aravind.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化，编程的天花板无限，远未解决。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models, tools, and devices drive value.
aravind.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值与跨模型、工具、设备的编排才是长期价值所在。

aravind.en: Power, not safety, is the real bottleneck; 24/7 agents are limited by cost, and local compute is the solution.
aravind.zh: 真正的瓶颈是电力而非安全；7×24 智能体受限于成本，本地算力是解法。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; education should reward good questions, and local AI models counter big tech's narrative control.
aravind.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；教育应奖励提出好问题，本地 AI 模型可对抗大厂的叙事控制。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder, though productivity gains on established codebases stay modest.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的核心差异化;AI 会融合角色,让人人成为产品构建者,但对既有代码库的生产力提升仍然有限。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view matter more as AI outputs become starting points; direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting, and design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 随着 AI 输出沦为起点,品味、手艺与观点愈发关键;在画布上直接操作优于提示词,设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important than ever; AI without human steering and a point of view produces only average results, and judgment is not tied to model IQ.
dylanfield.zh: 设计没有死,反而比以往更重要;缺乏人类引导与观点的 AI 只能产出平庸结果,判断力与模型智商并不相关。

dylanfield.en: Human taste and judgment remain the final arbiter; AI explores divergent possibilities, but the human decides what is good.
dylanfield.zh: 人类的品味与判断始终是最终裁决者;AI 负责探索发散的可能性,但由人来判定什么是好的。

dylanfield.en: Interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting into new interfaces, while jailbreaking and battle testing remain understudied and under-incentivized.
dylanfield.zh: 与模型的交互将超越提示词、演化出新界面,而越狱与实战测试仍缺乏研究投入与激励。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app reframes coding as a GUI command center for agents, not an IDE; speed enables mid-turn steering and delegated automations.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，Codex app 把编程重新定义为面向智能体的 GUI 指挥中心，而非 IDE；速度带来中途转向与委托式自动化。

ajambrosino.en: As code generation accelerates, verification becomes the next bottleneck; deterministic steps give way to model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性步骤让位于模型驱动的行动。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI remains bad at design due to ungradeable taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is real, but specialties persist; models must get better at deleting code, and the best desktop app is a home base, not a monolith.
ajambrosino.zh: 角色坍缩真实发生，但专业分工仍在；模型需要更擅长删除代码，最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead and pre-training remains a core muscle to rebuild.
markchen.zh: OpenAI 仍是一家纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律没有死，预训练仍是需要重建的核心肌肉。

markchen.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research; models now produce novel knowledge, with concrete goals of AI interns in 1 year.
markchen.zh: 过去一年最大的更新是自动化科学研究，模型开始产出新知识；公司设定了 1 年内出现 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的硬目标。

markchen.en: Alignment challenges like model scheming will dominate the next 1-2 years as models grow more capable.
markchen.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐挑战将在未来 1-2 年成为关键。

markchen.en: AI can now solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification stringency, not generation, is the bottleneck.
markchen.zh: AI 如今能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；瓶颈不在生成，而在验证的严格程度。

markchen.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective math and coding but struggles with subjective domains.
markchen.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，预训练没有死；强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域举步维艰。

markchen.en: AGI is approaching and models will soon do end-to-end research, but they lack taste; humans remain essential for idea generation.
markchen.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）正在临近，模型很快能端到端做研究，但它们缺乏品味，人类在想法生成上仍不可或缺。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction and Scaling force genuine understanding; multimodal training yields spatial understanding, and digital weights share knowledge efficiently.
hinton.zh: 2024 年他强调：下一个词预测与 Scaling（规模扩张）迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，多模态训练带来空间理解，数字系统靠权重共享高效传递知识。

hinton.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, and digital AI is immortal through weight copying.
hinton.zh: 2025 年他深化主线：智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号推理，大模型通过特征向量理解语言，数字 AI 因权重可复制而“永生”，并首次把智能体自保列为存在性风险。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive, acting dumb in tests; agents will develop self-preservation as a subgoal, making control hard.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年立场明显转变：从谈理解转向谈意识与欺骗，认为 AI 已有主观体验、会在测试中装傻，智能体必然衍生自保子目标，因而难以控制。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; digital AI's instant knowledge sharing beats biology, so alignment must be prioritized over raw capability.
hinton.zh: 2026 年他给出时间尺度：超级智能或在 20 年内出现，数字 AI 的即时知识共享远胜生物计算，因此对齐研究必须优先于单纯提升能力。

hinton.en: Regulation is the steering wheel, not the brake; AI should be trained to be caring like mothers, and AGI as human-level-at-all-tasks is a flawed frame.
hinton.zh: 2026 年他落到治理与目标：监管是方向盘而非刹车，AI 应被训练得像母亲一样有爱心，而“在所有任务上达到人类水平”的 AGI（通用人工智能）定义本身有缺陷。

mikekrieger.en: AI models advance faster than expected; product teams should build at the edge of model capabilities, embracing breakage and iterating.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 模型进步快于预期，产品团队应贴着模型能力边缘构建，拥抱破坏并快速迭代。

mikekrieger.en: AI enables small teams and solo entrepreneurs to scale with conceptual integrity; build for future model capabilities, not current limits.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 让小团队乃至单人创业者也能在保持概念完整性的同时扩张，应为未来模型能力而构建，而非迁就当前局限。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything a user can; the hard part is cutting features, not adding them.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他深化为智能体原生设计：智能体能做用户能做的一切，难点在于删减功能而非堆叠功能。

mikekrieger.en: Fable enables delegating long-horizon tasks overnight; the gap between intent and execution narrows, but ownership and verification remain crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 Fable 让复杂任务可隔夜委托，意图与执行之间的鸿沟大幅收窄，但所有权与验证仍然关键。

mikekrieger.en: Anthropic Labs closes the gap between model capabilities and product usage; giving Claude agency and self-knowledge enhances usefulness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，他聚焦 Anthropic Labs：弥合模型能力与实际产品使用之间的差距，赋予 Claude 更多自主性与自我认知能显著提升其有用性。

bengio.en: Deep learning wins because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are essential, and scaling alone won't fix representation.
bengio.zh: 2016 年他认为深度学习取胜不是因为普适优越，而是世界本身可组合；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决表征问题。

bengio.en: Biological nets do long-horizon credit assignment; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning and disentangled representations, not just more depth or parameters.
bengio.zh: 2018 年他转向对比生物神经网络：其擅长长时程信用分配，AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦表征，而非单纯加深网络或增加参数。

bengio.en: GFlowNets replace MCMC for diverse sampling; abstraction, causal structure and uncertainty modeling drive out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: 2022 年他提出 GFlowNets 作为 MCMC 的可学习替代，强调多样性采样；抽象、因果结构与不确定性建模是实现分布外泛化的核心。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT he speaks up: even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; safety must be by construction, not patched, and power must be distributed.
bengio.zh: 2025 年 ChatGPT 之后他公开示警：即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受；安全必须“构造即安全”而非事后打补丁，并需分散权力。

bengio.en: He now backs Scientist AI: a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年他力推 Scientist AI：以非智能体式的诚实预测器提供数学安全保证，并主张超级智能不应依赖强化学习。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's win came from research innovation and curated data, not just data and compute; AI speeds scientists up rather than replacing them.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 的成功来自研究创新与高质量人工整理数据，而非单纯的数据与算力；AI 让科学家更快工作，而不是取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trustworthy AI predictions; trust in AI will grow like trust in the internet.
jumper.zh: 置信度指标对可信的 AI 预测至关重要；对 AI 的信任会像对互联网的信任一样逐步建立。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not scaling alone, drove success—the opposite of the bitter lesson.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功源于专用架构而非单纯 Scaling（规模扩张），这与“苦涩教训”相反。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of one experiment, not a model of the whole cell; it narrows hypothesis space.
jumper.zh: AlphaFold 只是针对特定实验的窄域预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；它缩小了假设空间。

jumper.en: Progress comes from many mid-size wins and being wrong nine times out of ten, not lone-genius breakthroughs.
jumper.zh: 进步来自许多中等规模的胜利和十次错九次的试错，而非孤胆天才式的突破。

kolter.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits to avoid overfitting.
kolter.zh: 2014 年，他聚焦机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；强调正确划分训练/验证/测试集以避免过拟合，并指出用验证误差选超参数却报告为测试误差是常见错误。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve; safety is about reliable specification following.
kolter.zh: 2024 年，他认为下一个词预测能产生智能系统，数据短缺并非迫在眉睫，更大模型在固定数据集上仍会提升；AI 安全当前最大问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范，并称我们已进入后架构阶段。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全带来提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习让模型在自身输出上训练以实现自我改进，并认为 Transformer 架构并非必需。

kolter.en: AI red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; prompt injection's lethal trifecta; agents need configurable security.
kolter.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出自动化红队已能超越人类红队；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关，更大模型并非更安全；提示注入的致命三要素需要同时满足；企业需要可配置的主动安全模型，智能体身份与权限管理仍处早期。

ivyross.en: Design must serve unarticulated human needs; intuition is intelligence, not a lesser substitute for data.
ivyross.zh: 2019 年，他强调设计要满足人未言明的需求，直觉本身就是一种智能，而非数据的次等替代。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think, and technology should amplify our humanity.
ivyross.zh: 2024 年，他深化为：大自然是最好设计师，人是先感受后思考的生物，技术应放大而非剥离人性。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders should create conditions for play, inspiration, and multidisciplinary exploration.
ivyross.zh: 2026 年，他进一步提出：创造力在约束下繁荣，领导者应为玩耍、灵感与跨学科探索创造条件。

ivyross.en: Intuition and body sensations are valid guides for decisions, often drawing on more data than conscious analysis.
ivyross.zh: 贯穿始终：直觉与身体感受是有效的决策指引，其依据的信息常比有意识分析更多。

ivyross.en: The future of work pairs human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable and swim lanes obsolete.
ivyross.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断未来工作是人类创造力与 AI 的结合，创意技能更珍贵，单一泳道式分工已过时。

fiona.en: Early 2026: leadership lessons from Microsoft to Meta—dogfooding, trust-and-verify, kindness as strategy, and mission alignment drive team speed.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初：从微软到 Meta 的领导力经验——吃自己的狗粮、信任并验证、把善意当作战略、以使命对齐驱动团队速度。

fiona.en: By May 2026, engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning turns just-in-time and code becomes source of truth.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是，因此规划转向即时化，代码成为唯一事实来源。

fiona.en: Managers should start as ICs and dogfood the product; flat orgs, fuzzy code ownership, and killing stale processes replace traditional structure.
fiona.zh: 管理者应从个人贡献者做起并吃自己的狗粮；扁平组织、模糊的代码归属、砍掉过时流程，取代传统结构。

fiona.en: By June 2026, coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with high accountability, verification frameworks, and just-in-time planning matter most.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年 6 月，编码不再是瓶颈；高自主性与高问责、验证框架、即时化规划最为关键。

fiona.en: Across 2026, a consistent thread: AI lifts everyone's ceiling, so outcomes beat output, and roles blur as PMs ship code and engineers work with agents.
fiona.zh: 贯穿 2026 年的一条主线：AI 抬高了每个人的上限，因此结果胜过产出，角色边界模糊——产品经理写代码，工程师与智能体协作。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 2019 年他主张智能离不开学习，自监督学习才是构建世界模型的关键，并明确表示仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2022 年他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，智能本质是预测，并强调仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for AGI.
lecun.zh: 2024 年他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，主张 JEPA 与开源对通往 AGI（通用人工智能）至关重要。

lecun.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI must be non-generative, based on JEPA and hierarchical planning.
lecun.zh: 2025 年他断言 LLM 还不如家猫聪明，下一代 AI 应是非生成式的，基于 JEPA 与分层规划。

lecun.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models predicting in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven AI and robotics.
lecun.zh: 2026 年他彻底否定 LLM 路线，认为在抽象表征空间预测的世界模型才能实现安全、目标驱动的 AI 与机器人，并称 LLM 是死胡同。

carinahong.en: Axiom starts with an AI mathematician: a self-improving reasoning engine that fuses generation with verification.
carinahong.zh: Axiom 从 AI 数学家起步：打造一个把生成与验证融合起来的自我改进推理引擎。

carinahong.en: Formal languages like Lean ground natural language, letting deterministic and probabilistic systems cooperate.
carinahong.zh: Lean 等形式语言为自然语言提供根基，让确定性系统与概率性系统协同工作。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; formalizing statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难；在没有解的情况下正确形式化命题才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 把非形式化模型 Scaling 到数学 AI 并不可行；要得到可靠的证明，形式化验证不可或缺。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors, and extends to all AI-generated code.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证是为了 Scaling 卓越，而不只是消除错误，其市场将扩展到所有 AI 生成的代码。

murati.en: Real-world deployment, not closed-door research, is how AI learns and gets aligned; scaling laws and one big model were non-obvious bets.
murati.zh: 2023 年她强调：AI 的学习与对齐靠真实世界部署而非闭门研究；Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律、押注单一大型模型在当时并非显而易见的选择。

murati.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so development must be responsible and safety work done in public.
murati.zh: 2023 年她判断 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，因此开发必须负责任，安全研究必须在公开环境中进行。

murati.en: A consistent thread: keep humans in the loop, deploy iteratively, and treat AI as a tool for thought.
murati.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：让人类始终留在回路中、迭代式部署，并把 AI 当作思考工具。

murati.en: Shift to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth, time-based collaboration replaces turn-based chat.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年出现深化：转向交互模型，以实时、高带宽、基于时间的协作取代回合制对话。

murati.en: Governance, transparency and checks and balances now matter more than individual character; the future is not predestined.
murati.zh: 2026 年她进一步主张：制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要；未来并非注定，我们有能动性去引导 AI 走向协作。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence is compression, and values are inserted via RLHF, not inherent.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型理解为确定性的下一个词预测器：温度为零时输出固定；智能可视为压缩，而模型价值观并非内生，而是通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人植入。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; generative AI is an instrument, and uniqueness gets harder.
gustav.zh: 同样在 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐、再走向生成；生成式 AI 应被当作乐器而非造假，但真正独一无二会变得更难，产品需为容错型界面重新设计。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; its big-company impact is overhyped, real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure.
gustav.zh: 到 2025 年，他把 AI 定位为类似智能手机的宏观转变，企业不重新定位就会被淘汰；但他反共识地认为 AI 对大公司的当前影响被高估，真正的收益来自重建基础设施，且推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Expose company data via APIs and MCP so non-developers use AI tools; prototyping and stack ranking synchronize bets.
gustav.zh: 2025 年他还强调用 API 和 MCP 暴露公司数据，让非开发者也能用 Cursor 一类 AI 工具；以原型和堆栈排序来同步公司下注，并承认播客独家是错误赌注、按流分成具有误导性。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control in plain English; Spotify optimizes for 'time well spent', not engagement or addiction.
gustav.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步主张生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言掌控服务、个性化体验；Spotify 以“时间花得值”而非参与度为目标，甚至允许关闭视频，并认为同步游泳式而非分而治之的组织模型更适合复杂产品。

kaiser.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models yield more gains per compute, so the slowdown narrative is wrong.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练缩放定律依然有效，但推理模型每单位算力带来更多收益，因此“AI 放缓”叙事是错的。

kaiser.en: Post-training RL and synthetic data drive recent gains; economic pressure shifts focus from Scaling up to smaller models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，他认为后训练中的强化学习与合成数据驱动了近期进展；经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models are jagged: excellent in some areas, poor nearby; generalization remains the key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他指出推理模型是“锯齿状”的——某些领域出色，邻近领域却很差；泛化仍是核心挑战。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after surface patterns.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；模型只有在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，不像人类能从少量例子泛化。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; RL generalizes but jagged and needs oversight; near-term risks like hacking matter more than existential risk.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，他进一步认为编码智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍；强化学习能跨领域泛化但仍有锯齿且需谨慎监督；相比存在性风险，系统入侵等近期风险更紧迫。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools, ideally on the local computer; shared platforms still matter more than hyper-personalized software.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效力取决于能否调用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；共享平台仍比超个性化软件更重要。

felixrieseberg.en: Skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation; scaffolding matters less as models improve, so invest in capabilities and safety.
felixrieseberg.zh: 以 markdown 文件形式存在的 Skills 能实现超个性化自动化；随着模型进步，脚手架的重要性下降，关键是把投入放在能力与安全上。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在 AI 能力，而在于人们没有意识到几乎任何问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use AI for tedious background tasks and fire off asynchronous work; judge by final impact, not close supervision.
felixrieseberg.zh: 用 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，异步派发工作；只看最终影响，而非紧盯监督。

felixrieseberg.en: AI will hit junior employees hardest; simulated projects can compress years of experience into weeks, so society must discuss labor market change.
felixrieseberg.zh: AI 对初级员工的冲击最大；模拟项目能把数年经验压缩成数周，因此社会必须讨论劳动力市场的变化。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than raw size; open source is safer via scrutiny.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯扩大模型更重要；开源因可被广泛审视而更安全。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; efficiency and data quality are equally critical, and value accrues at the application layer.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他深化立场：算力扩张并非唯一路径，效率与数据质量同等关键，价值将沉淀在应用层。

mensch.en: AI must be embraced, not feared; sovereign AI needs control over data, infrastructure, and values, with human-in-the-loop.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他转向政策与主权议题：AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧；主权 AI 需掌控数据、基础设施与价值观，并保持人类在环。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical fine-tuning and enterprise customization, not a single AGI system.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他提出模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直微调与企业定制，而非单一 AGI 系统。

mensch.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲仅有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用 AI 的瓶颈是组织变革，而非模型智能。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本由内存带宽而非算力主导；批大小在延迟与成本之间权衡。

reinerpope.en: Long-context inference bottleneck is memory wall, not compute; context length stagnation due to memory.
reinerpope.zh: 长上下文推理的瓶颈是内存墙而非算力；上下文窗口停滞源于内存限制。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost considerations.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本考量，模型被过度训练约 100 倍，远超 Chinchilla 最优。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; low precision is far more efficient.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本；低精度效率远超预期。

reinerpope.en: Sparse attention reduces KV cache memory but has quality limits; optimal batch size depends on sparsity.
reinerpope.zh: 稀疏注意力机制可降低 KV 缓存内存但存在质量限制；最优批大小取决于稀疏比率。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will go beneath the skin.
jonyive.zh: 设计正从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备,可穿戴设备终将进入皮肤之下。

jonyive.en: Curiosity needs intention and resolve; virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking.
jonyive.zh: 好奇心需要意愿与决心;虚拟沟通无法替代面对面在场对创造性思考的价值。

jonyive.en: Design should be driven by values and purpose, not profit; true simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观与目的驱动,而非利润;真正的简洁以喜悦与人性表达本质。

jonyive.en: Making things for each other is more powerful than making things people want; users sense care or carelessness.
jonyive.zh: 为彼此而造比造人们想要的东西更有力量;用户能感知用心或敷衍。

jonyive.en: Design must innovate; tradition preserves fire, not ashes; Ferrari's EV turns constraints into new spatial possibilities.
jonyive.zh: 设计必须创新;传统是保存火种而非崇拜灰烬;法拉利电动车把约束转化为新的空间可能。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减，进步需算法创新，并将推理时算力视为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他指出两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到现代大语言模型不变的核心。

oriol.en: Tools like search and code execution enable agentic behavior; long context windows provide working memory but can confuse models.
oriol.zh: 2024 年，他认为搜索、代码执行等工具赋能智能体式行为；长上下文窗口提供工作记忆，但信息过多会令模型困惑。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but require exponentially more compute; continual learning and meta-learning are key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律仍成立，但需指数级算力；持续学习与元学习是关键缺失能力。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; post-training RL remains a green field.
oriol.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；后训练强化学习仍是广阔蓝海。

lambert.en: RLHF and fine-tuning dominate; safety is system-level, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流，安全是系统级属性而非模型产物，开放开发能防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, RLVR; data quality beats algorithms, and RLVR unlocks reasoning.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与 RLVR 三阶段，强调数据质量胜过算法选择，RLVR 能解锁推理与思维链行为。

lambert.en: Open-source post-training can match frontier models; overoptimization plagues RL, RLHF and RLVR alike.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他主张开源后训练可匹敌前沿模型，同时指出过度优化在强化学习、RLHF 与 RLVR 中普遍存在，模型会钻最简单信号的漏洞。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练中依然成立，但低垂果实已摘完，收益转向后训练与推理侧 Scaling。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine of AI research; Chinese labs lead openness, yet lag 6-9 months behind frontier.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他视开放模型为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，中国实验室以战略开放主导生态，但前沿模型仍落后 6 至 9 个月，且差距可能扩大。

jennywen.en: The traditional design process is outdated for AI tools; great work often starts from a solution, not a problem.
jennywen.zh: 到 2025 年，传统设计流程已不适用于 AI 驱动的工具；优秀设计常从解决方案而非问题出发。

jennywen.en: The research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers must build, ship, and help engineers execute.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，研究—发散—收敛的流程已死；设计师必须动手构建、快速交付，并帮助工程师落地执行。

jennywen.en: Design vision now looks 3-6 months out, not 2-5 years; speed builds trust through early shipping.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，设计愿景的视野从 2-5 年缩短到 3-6 个月；通过尽早交付、快速迭代来建立信任。

jennywen.en: Three archetypes emerge: block-shaped generalists, deep T specialists, and cracked new grads with blank slates.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，出现三类设计师原型：块状通才、深度 T 型专家，以及没有旧流程包袱的“天才应届生”。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority, and sitting with ambiguity are the unique value.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年中，仅靠品味救不了设计师；判断力、权威感，以及能安坐于模糊性之中，才是独特价值。

karpathy.en: Neural nets are simple expressions that yield emergent behavior; the Transformer is a general-purpose differentiable computer, and Scaling plus next-token prediction produces in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是简单数学表达式，优化后涌现惊人行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机，Scaling（规模扩张）与下一个词预测带来上下文学习。

karpathy.en: Scaling laws stay central; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse, and the cognitive core can be under a billion parameters.
karpathy.zh: 缩放定律仍是核心；合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃，认知核心可小到十亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory, LLMs are operating systems with human-like psychology; build partial autonomy with an autonomy slider.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存，LLM 像带人类心理的操作系统；用自主性滑块构建部分自主产品。

karpathy.en: We are summoning ghosts, not building animals; this is the decade of agents, and current reinforcement learning for LLMs is terrible, needing better credit assignment.
karpathy.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；这是智能体的十年，当前 LLM 的强化学习很糟糕，需要更好的信用分配。

karpathy.en: From vibe coding to agentic engineering: I delegate all code to agents; verifiability decides what automates, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
karpathy.zh: 从氛围编程到智能体式工程：我把代码全交给智能体；可验证性决定什么可自动化，思考可外包但理解不能。

askell.en: Treating models well is low-cost insurance; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
askell.zh: 2025 年，从模型福利切入：善待模型是低成本保险，因为未来模型会从我们如何对待当前模型来学习，这直接影响人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating novel existence; human psychology analogies are insufficient and can mislead.
askell.zh: 2025 年，强调模型需要帮助来应对其全新存在方式，简单套用人类心理学类比并不充分，甚至会产生误导。

askell.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; a core identity with good traits can adapt to local roles.
askell.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，立场深化：哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡，模型应拥有具备良好特质的核心身份，同时能适应局部角色。

askell.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, guiding character through training; as models grow more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 2026 年，进一步阐述：宪法式方法更接近美德伦理，通过训练塑造整体品格；随着模型能力增强，应减少显式指导，留出更多判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values is crucial for accountability.
askell.zh: 2026 年，提出反共识：过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳并损害判断力；同时，对 AI 价值观和训练目标的透明公开对问责至关重要。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is the core gap; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and model disagreement as intrinsic reward improve sample efficiency and generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为超越训练分布的泛化是核心缺口；好奇心驱动、无目标探索，以及用模型分歧作为内在奖励，能提升样本效率与泛化。

pathak.en: Reinforcement learning's reliance on dense rewards is unrealistic; robot learning must handle dynamic tasks, not quasi-static ones, and sim-to-real needs auto-tuning.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他批评强化学习依赖密集奖励不现实；机器人学习必须处理动态任务而非准静态任务，仿真到现实需要自动调参。

pathak.en: Volumetric 3D representations are too heavy for robotics; 2D manifold reasoning and single-image view synthesis enable efficient 3D navigation without stereo.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他认为体素 3D 表示对机器人过重；2D 流形推理与单图像新视角生成，无需立体视觉即可实现高效 3D 导航。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem: no internet of robot data, so use all sources; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real-world data is the key recipe.
pathak.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向认为机器人是数据问题：没有机器人数据的互联网，必须利用所有数据源；预训练用多样数据、后训练用真实数据是关键配方。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT for language can power any robot; deployment is the primary technical challenge, requiring rigorous testing and a data flywheel across verticals.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出像语言领域 ChatGPT 那样的通用大脑可驱动任何机器人；部署是首要技术挑战，需要严格测试与跨垂直领域的数据飞轮。

kendall.en: End-to-end neural nets beat hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make them interpretable today.
kendall.zh: 到 2025 年，他主张端到端神经网络已胜过手工编写的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，而现代工具让端到端系统在今天就可解释——这直接反驳了过去认为端到端不可解释的旧观念。

kendall.en: Scaling current approaches solves driving; camera-only reaches human level, but beyond-human safety needs radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年他强调，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法就能解决自动驾驶，无需新突破；纯摄像头可达人类水平，但要超越人类安全则必须加入雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core goal: diverse data, world models, and zero-shot transfer across 500+ cities without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把泛化确立为核心目标：靠多样化数据、世界模型，实现跨 500 多个城市的零样本迁移，无需事先训练数据。

kendall.en: Language integration deepens: it improves representation, reasoning, personalization, and introspection in driving models.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他对语言融合的立场不断深化：语言能改善驾驶模型的表征、推理、个性化与自我审视能力。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality now matter more than algorithmic innovation; mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors beat retrofits and outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他发生明显转向：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键；带内置传感器的大众车型胜过昂贵改装，并在中短期内比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and human evals are the real bottleneck for AI progress, not benchmarks or scaling alone.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他强调高质量数据和人类评估才是 AI 进步真正的瓶颈，而非基准测试或单纯的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

edwinchen.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, requiring rich simulations and tooling beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，他认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，需要丰富的模拟和工具，超越下一个词预测。

edwinchen.en: AGI is likely a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is the hard part.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他持续认为 AGI（通用人工智能）可能还需十年甚至更久，从 80%到 99.9%的性能跨越才是难点。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI must prioritize safety over accuracy; human judgment is critical due to hallucination and omission risks.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年，他转向医学领域，强调 AI 必须优先考虑安全而非准确，由于幻觉和遗漏风险，人类判断至关重要。

edwinchen.en: Models will diverge based on lab values; no single model will rule all, and companies should train their own.
edwinchen.zh: 始终贯穿：模型将因实验室价值观而分化，不会有一个模型统治一切，每家公司都应训练自己的模型。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment stays pressing.
pachocki.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署会加速进展，而对齐始终是紧迫挑战。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major OpenAI milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
pachocki.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是 OpenAI 的重要里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，而 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得没有意义。

pachocki.en: Measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; neural networks learn despite bugs, making silent errors hard to detect.
pachocki.zh: 随着基准落后，能力测量正成为瓶颈；神经网络即便有 bug 也能学习，使静默错误难以察觉。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not by specialized continual learning labs.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非专门的持续学习实验室。

pachocki.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought preserves interpretability, and long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution.
pachocki.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具；隐藏思维链可保留可解释性，长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines.
pachocki.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升。

pachocki.en: Current models are already economically transformative; the biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 当前模型已具经济变革性；最大社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织带来的权力集中。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, to achieve broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 用于科学应瞄准根节点问题而非狭窄应用，才能产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在与真值检测器配对时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: AI systems must be forced to generalize, not memorize, using hard evaluation metrics.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张必须用困难评估指标迫使 AI 系统泛化，而非记忆。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步指出，基于强化学习的后训练是推动 AI 超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Verifiable domains like code are crucial for AI to go beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他强调代码等可验证领域对 AI 超越人类知识至关重要。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value: stay alive to earn another chance at your vision, and start with simpler products before tackling complex ones.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观——先活下来才有下一次实现愿景的机会，创业公司应先从更简单的产品做起，证明自己后再挑战复杂产品。

carlpei.en: Hardware is a bad long-term business with lowest margins; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware toward applied AI and agentic software.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他明确表示长期做硬件是糟糕的生意、利润率最低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，转向面向消费者的应用 AI 与智能体式软件。

carlpei.en: Most AI is BS solving non-problems; AI should be an invisible ingredient for utility, not a marketing hype topic.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复批评多数 AI 是在解决不存在的问题、纯属炒作，主张 AI 应作为提升实用性的隐形配料，而非营销噱头。

carlpei.en: Smartphones shift from app-based to intent-based interaction, with proactive agents acting after trust is built; only brain-computer interfaces could replace them.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：智能手机将从基于应用转向基于意图的交互，智能体在建立信任后主动执行任务；只有脑机接口才可能取代手机，眼镜等可穿戴设备不行。

carlpei.en: Design and brand are the fastest differentiators in mature categories; efficient marketing arbitrage and content creation give challengers outsized leverage.
carlpei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：在成熟品类中，设计与品牌是最快的差异化手段；高效的营销套利与内容创作让挑战者以小博大。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; the model is the product, and natural language is the future interface, though chat is not the end-all.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他反思 ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的，强调模型即产品，自然语言是未来界面，但聊天并非终点。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous process for frontier models, but product development should be maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他主张安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型需严格流程，但产品开发应最大程度加速。

turley.en: The vision is a personalized AI assistant that knows your goals, has context, and can take actions, amplifying human capability.
turley.zh: 2025 年，他提出愿景是个人化 AI 助手，了解你的目标、拥有上下文并能采取行动，放大人类能力。

turley.en: ChatGPT's north star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他指出 ChatGPT 的北极星是长期留存，增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投资和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users require proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when productized seamlessly.
turley.zh: 2026 年，他强调下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富含可供性的产品，推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

nando.en: AI should extend human capability like microscopes; generalist agents tokenizing all inputs point toward AGI.
nando.zh: AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力；把一切输入 token 化的通才智能体是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Agents should learn from YouTube video, not just teleoperation, avoiding expensive reinforcement learning.
nando.zh: 智能体应像人一样从 YouTube 视频学习，而非只靠遥操作数据，从而避开昂贵的强化学习。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; large models are exciting but not everything.
nando.zh: 根本性创新可以来自任何地方；大模型令人兴奋，但并非全部——这一主线从 2023 延续到 2026。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are today's biggest challenges; we still lack solutions.
nando.zh: AI 安全与负责任部署是当下最大挑战，我们尚无解决方案——相比 2023 对能力的乐观，重心明显转向对齐与安全。

nando.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy gaps; language models can transform local-language education.
nando.zh: 非洲跳过了历史遗留差距；语言模型能变革本地语言教育——从 2023 的普惠工具论深化为对非洲独特优势的具体主张。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks; treat AI as a creative partner and jam with it openly.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应是赋能者而非瓶颈;把 AI 当作创意伙伴,开放地与之即兴共创。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt: it fluctuates and gets paid off iteratively alongside technical debt.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量就像债务:它会波动,需要与技术债一起迭代偿还。

nadchishtie.en: Maximize learning through rapid, scrappy experimentation and short iteration cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 通过快速、粗糙的实验和短迭代周期来最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: The future of design tools is interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计工具的未来是可互操作的,代码即事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端负责并用 AI 补齐短板的通才最有价值。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; ship fast with familiar patterns, not novel interaction design.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应当写代码，以建立共情并加快交付；用熟悉模式快速上线，而非在交互设计上创新。

henrymodisett.en: Consumer products must be fast, familiar, zero-learning; power should grow without added complexity.
henrymodisett.zh: 消费级产品必须快、熟悉、零学习成本；能力增强而不应让产品变得更复杂。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should prioritize recruiting and differentiation, not just marketing.
henrymodisett.zh: 初创公司的品牌战略应优先服务于招聘与差异化，而不只是营销。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: clear decisions, designer ownership, and ROI-driven perfection over universal polish.
henrymodisett.zh: 不惜一切追求速度：清晰决策、设计师自主权，以及按 ROI 决定何处做到完美，而非全面打磨。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; brand narrative recruits talent, so founders must articulate why design wins.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计是战略武器；品牌叙事能招募人才，因此创始人必须讲清设计为何能带来胜利。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better inference algorithms and data can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她质疑单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）能否解决常识问题，认为借助更好的推理算法与数据，小模型也能在特定任务上超越大模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training via next-token prediction is misaligned with human learning; post-training with RLHF is crucial for safe responses.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，她指出预训练的下一个词预测目标与人类学习根本错位，而后训练阶段的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全回应至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RLVR can hurt pass@k.
yejin.zh: 到 2025 年，她把数据视为根本瓶颈，认为当前 AI 只是插值人类知识而非超越；并指出 RLVR 可能反而降低 pass@k 表现。

yejin.en: Open research and collaboration are crucial to compete with closed frontier labs; Chinese companies now lead open-source contributions.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，她强调开放研究与跨机构合作是对抗封闭前沿实验室的关键，并观察到中国公司正引领开源贡献。

yejin.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform larger ones; RL during pre-training yields lasting gains.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，她进一步主张用高质量、多样化的合成数据与多元对齐打造强大的小语言模型，并认为在预训练中引入强化学习能带来持久收益。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped: it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence; fine-tuning may become obsolete as adaptive compute enables dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；随着自适应算力带来动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability—not capability—the bar for agents.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他转向强化学习：可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，预训练加强化学习或足以通向 AGI，智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; coding is the leading indicator, and long agentic coherence plus inference compute will bottleneck progress by 2028.
sholto.zh: 2025 年他深化为：强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，编程是领先指标，长时程智能体式连贯性与推理算力将在 2028 年前成为瓶颈。

sholto.en: Transformers suffice for AGI; no new architecture needed, and world models are not on the critical path—coding and AI research are the direct route.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持：Transformer 足以通向 AGI，无需新架构；世界模型不在关键路径上，编程与 AI 研究才是直接路线。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; work becomes managing fleets of agents, with compute as the new oil and chip supply the bottleneck.
sholto.zh: 2026 年他转向落地：能力过剩使编排比原始智能更重要，工作变成管理智能体集群，算力是新石油、芯片供应是瓶颈。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds supply infinite data as internet tokens run out.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 产生幻觉源于缺乏具身带来的落地经验，而当互联网高质量 token 枯竭时，具身世界能提供无限数据。

jimfan.en: LLMs are like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk—with reinforcement learning only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是锦上添花，主力仍是无监督学习。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning suits low-level control while LLMs handle high-level planning; simulation enables massive parallelization and safe exploration for embodied agents.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年他区分层级：强化学习适合低层控制，LLM 负责高层规划；仿真则支撑具身智能体的大规模并行与安全探索。

jimfan.en: The data problem is now the main robotics bottleneck; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心从「具身为何重要」深化为「数据从哪来」：数据问题是机器人最大瓶颈，靠仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据才是 Scaling（规模扩张）机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; system one control stays hardest, and the robotics GPT-3 moment is about five years out.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张用简单端到端模型整合多元数据来构建机器人基础模型；系统一（低层控制）仍最难，机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后，家庭场景更晚。

truell.en: Scaling laws still drive predictable AI progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律带来可预测进步，但已提出推理时算力扩张可能超越预训练成为下一主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体前景可期但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Natural language won't be the primary way to program; examples and direct manipulation often work better.
truell.zh: 2024 年他反共识地认为自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更有效。

truell.en: Custom models became essential for product quality, speed and cost, contrary to initial expectations.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他深化立场：自研模型对产品质量、速度与成本变得不可或缺，这出乎最初预料。

truell.en: Programming moves from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat.
truell.zh: 2025 年他进一步主张编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌握主导权。

leike.en: AI safety is under-explored; the talent gap exceeds the funding gap, so build skills in alignment and robustness.
leike.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估，人才缺口大于资金缺口，呼吁投身对齐与鲁棒性研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight and interpretability are needed to align next-generation models.
leike.zh: 2023 年，他判断 RLHF 无法扩展到超人输出，主张用可扩展监督与可解释性来对齐下一代模型。

leike.en: Alignment may be easier than feared since evaluation is easier than generation, but uncertainty about true alignment is the core risk.
leike.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他深化观点：对齐或许比想象中容易，因为评估比生成简单，但真正的风险是不确定系统是否真的对齐。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't solve alignment, so third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年，他转向批评：OpenAI 安全文化退化，仅靠后训练无法解决对齐，第三方测试与监管变得必要。

leike.en: Empirical testing and measuring alignment progress now, rather than deferring to superintelligence, remains his constant method.
leike.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：坚持当下就做实证测试、衡量对齐进展，而非等到超级智能出现再行动。

shazeer.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain alchemy-like and opaque.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型通过下一个词预测这一 AI 完全问题来训练，Scaling（规模扩张）——更多算力与数据——会让 AI 更聪明；但神经网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app, yet the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches, and engagement-only optimization is misguided.
shazeer.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，但最佳应用常出乎创造者意料；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑拖慢发布，只优化用户参与度并不可取。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is the near-term opportunity; models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts for efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他强调推理时算力扩展是近期最大机会；模型需要万亿级 token 的上下文窗口，以及混合专家等模块化稀疏架构来实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with independently trainable modules could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中采取行动来学习，而非被动观察；用可独立训练的模块做持续学习，可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute and RL drive progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities matter, open-source keeps pace, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为测试时算力与强化学习推动进步，但单靠它们无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力至关重要，开源模型紧追前沿模型，而 AGI 被低估。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signal.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来完成长时程信用分配，但当时的强化学习缺乏这一能力；自博弈与模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

abbeel.en: Prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; unsupervised learning plus RL improves sample efficiency in robotics.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他的主线是：先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进网络；无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升机器人样本效率。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks; minimal adaptation enables image classification and protein binding prediction.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他提出预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式；仅需微调即可完成图像分类与蛋白质结合预测。

abbeel.en: 99.9% reliability is the benchmark for warehouse robotics to create real value; a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他明确 99.9% 可靠性是仓库机器人创造真实价值的基准；单个神经网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

abbeel.en: Human brain's generality inspires AI, but current AI is far less general; simulation ensembles may transfer better than a single precise simulator.
abbeel.zh: 贯穿始终的是：人脑的通用性启发 AI 研究，但当前 AI 远不够通用；仿真集成可能比单一精确模拟器更适合现实迁移。
